pieces.title: Vortex
pieces.note: Capsules ride a vortex field, colored by their speed. Click for another vortex.

pieces.title: Orb
pieces.note: A sphere of dots, sized and tinted by how they face you. Click for another orb.

pieces.title: Desordres
pieces.note: A square grid that loses its composure corner by corner. Click for another desordres.

pieces.title: Orbits
pieces.note: Chords inside three rings fake the circles they never draw. Click for another orbits.

pieces.title: Contours
pieces.note: Sixty lines share one travelling wave on paper white. Click for another contours.

pieces.title: Scanline
pieces.note: A disc of green scanlines, each exactly as long as its chord. Click for another scanline.

pieces.title: Vanishing
pieces.note: A floor of dots receding to one off-center point. Click for another vanishing.

pieces.title: Rain
pieces.note: Capsule rain on cream, stretched and tinted by two quiet fields. Click for another rain.

pieces.title: Shimmer
pieces.note: Dashed rings interfere until the target vibrates; one ring is red. Click for another shimmer.

pieces.title: Drift
pieces.note: 350 capsules ride three breathing vortices, laying neon trails. Click for a new current.

pieces.title: Halftone
pieces.note: Dot rings swell and shrink by one radial cosine, in indigo. Click for another halftone.

pieces.title: Globe
pieces.note: An icosphere wireframe with torn edges and a few in gold. Click for another globe.

pieces.title: Pack
pieces.note: Circles admitted largest first, only where nothing overlaps. Click for another pack.

pieces.title: Armature
pieces.note: Two wireframe solids turn against each other in neon. Click for a new form.

pieces.title: Modules
pieces.note: One primitive per filled module on a mostly empty Bauhaus grid. Click for another modules.

pieces.title: Phyllotaxis
pieces.note: A sunflower head in white and gold: the golden angle, nothing else. Click for another phyllotaxis.

pieces.title: Weave
pieces.note: Warp and weft capsules alternate, with faults where the parity flips. Click for another weave.

pieces.title: Lissajous
pieces.note: A closed orbit figure drawn in dots instead of a line. Click for another lissajous.

pieces.title: Stitch
pieces.note: Cross-stitches gather into a continent where a quiet field runs high. Click for another stitch.

pieces.title: Harmonograph
pieces.note: Two decaying pendulums draw one line that settles as it goes. Click for another harmonograph.

pieces.title: Ticks
pieces.note: Rings of ticks breathing at different rates; the longest tick of each ring is gold. Click for another ticks.

pieces.title: Bricks
pieces.note: A stretcher-bond wall in outline, one red brick hiding in every row. Click for another bricks.

pieces.title: Wedge
pieces.note: Stipple thrown and rejected by a gradient: solid at one corner, gone at the other. Click for another wedge.

pieces.title: Spiral
pieces.note: One spiral walked by arc length, stitched in capsules that lengthen outward. Click for another spiral.

pieces.title: Interference
pieces.note: Two straight waves multiply across a dot grid, breaking it into islands. Click for another interference.

pieces.title: Fan
pieces.note: Lines from one bright corner, cut into nested gold-banded frames. Click for another fan.

pieces.title: Moons
pieces.note: A 9 by 9 calendar of moon phases under one sun. Click for another moons.

pieces.title: Braids
pieces.note: Three strands, one of them red, woven over and under down the page. Click for another braids.

pieces.title: Eclipse
pieces.note: Rings whose center drifts as they grow, bunching on one side. Click for another eclipse.

pieces.title: Maze
pieces.note: A perfect maze, carved by rule, its one solution traced in red. Click for another maze.

pieces.title: Eleven Nets
pieces.note: All 11 nets of a cube; the hero folds itself into a box. Drag to fold.

pieces.title: Sixteen Trees
pieces.note: All 16 spanning trees of four dots, swept one panel at a time. Drag to move the sweep.

pieces.title: Ten Ways In
pieces.note: All 10 ways to pair four dots, visited one panel at a time. Drag to move the visit.

pieces.title: Twelve Cells
pieces.note: All 12 pentominoes, assembling themselves into a 6 by 10 rectangle. Drag to scrub the assembly.

pieces.title: Fifteen Chords
pieces.note: All 15 ways to pair six points on a circle, in flat neon. Drag to move the wave.

pieces.title: Twenty-Four Orders
pieces.note: All 24 orders of four colored dots, one adjacent swap per beat. Drag to scrub the order.

pieces.title: Fourteen Paths
pieces.note: All 14 Dyck staircases that never fall below their start. Drag to choose a path.

pieces.title: Thirty-Two Words
pieces.note: All 32 five-lamp words, lit in binary counting order. Drag to count.

pieces.title: Pendulum Web
pieces.note: A double pendulum weaving a fading web, deterministic to the step. Drag to set the release.

pieces.title: Moire Rings
pieces.note: Two dot-ring fields turning against each other; the interference is the picture. Drag to shift the phase.

pieces.title: Light Orbit
pieces.note: Three great circles of light turning on a black sphere. Drag to orbit.

pieces.title: Katalog 217D
pieces.note: Fourteen tracks lit by a seeded binary string, one in acid cyan. Drag to scrub the phase.

pieces.title: Wall of Light
pieces.note: Three beams of light sweeping a dark wall, brightening where they cross. Drag to shift the light.

pieces.title: Color Break
pieces.note: Five white elliptical loops; only the parts inside the invisible zone turn red. Drag to move the break.

pieces.title: Thirty Seconds
pieces.note: Seven Lissajous points, their trails fading over exactly thirty seconds. Drag to scrub time.

pieces.title: Voronoi Drift
pieces.note: Fibonacci sphere Voronoi cells; the amber pentagons and cyan heptagons wander as the count breathes. Drag to spin.

pieces.title: Pigment Water
pieces.note: Gray-Scott pigment blooms in red, amber and teal, split by black seams. Drag to stir in pigment.

pieces.title: Halftone Print
pieces.note: A live flow field printed as halftone dots, ink on paper. Drag to stir.

pieces.title: Generation 65
pieces.note: Six blob creatures crawl, and every ten seconds the best mover breeds the next generation. Drag to nudge them.

pieces.title: Mandelbulb Orbit
pieces.note: A ray-marched Mandelbulb on a slow closed orbit, bone lit with one cyan rim. Drag to orbit.

pieces.title: Chromesthetic Grid
pieces.note: A grid of arc-split color modules held apart by a black staff band; a retune wave recolors each module in turn. Drag to retune.

pieces.title: Rhythm and Colour
pieces.note: Concentric segmented rings whose colors march outward on the beat while the whole stack slowly turns. Drag to turn.

pieces.title: Intersecting Colour
pieces.note: Four horizontal and four vertical bands cross on bone, their overlaps snapping to flat mixed hues. Drag a band.

pieces.title: Chromatic Scale
pieces.note: Twelve tiles, one per semitone, each a two-color split; the sounding tile swaps its colors as the playhead passes. Drag to scrub.

pieces.title: Sonic Lumina
pieces.note: A field of two-color diagonal flags; a traveling band flips the flags it crosses. Drag to send a wave.

pieces.title: Egg Trace
pieces.note: A parametric egg of 1,200 points on stitched rings builds, rotates and dissolves. Drag to bend the egg.

pieces.title: Spirograph Knot
pieces.note: A hypotrochoid draws itself in ink, then a second ratio lays indigo lace over its gray ghost. Drag to shift the pen.

pieces.title: Pentagon Swarm
pieces.note: Ninety particles stream around a pentagon that snaps inside out into its star and back. Drag to swirl the swarm.

pieces.title: Six Twenty Five
pieces.note: Six hundred twenty five tiles scramble, then solve in a ripple from the center. Drag to scramble a patch.

pieces.title: One Stroke
pieces.note: One unbroken line draws a Lissajous bouquet, holds, then retraces itself away. Drag to change the ratio.

pieces.title: Momentary Composition
pieces.note: Layered flat shapes overlap on near black, crossfading into a new seeded composition. Drag to scrub the fade.

pieces.title: Pinwheel Field
pieces.note: Pinwheel diamonds counter-rotate in shifting row palettes of flat color. Drag to spin a pinwheel.

pieces.title: Bar Weave
pieces.note: Square cells packed edge to edge with pastel and saturated bars in a checker weave. Drag to re-pack a row.

pieces.title: Transparency Drift
pieces.note: Large translucent shapes breathe at the center, their overlaps drifting in color. Drag to raise a color.

pieces.title: Pascal's Field
pieces.note: A nine by nine pinwheel field colored by Pascal residues as the modulus cycles. Drag to ripple the count.

pieces.title: Folding Mutation
pieces.note: One ink organism folds into itself on warm Bristol, re-inked teal partway round. Drag to disturb the growth.

pieces.title: Ink Circuitry
pieces.note: Parallel ink traces bunch into channels through a warped field, a few in rust. Drag to pinch the flow.

pieces.title: Six Dishes
pieces.note: Six petri dishes grow at six densities, one ink each, taking turns. Drag to wake a dish.

pieces.title: Mineral Bloom
pieces.note: Pastel growths with dark outlines unfurl and refold as the curl breathes. Drag to stir the curl.

pieces.title: Graffiti Rift
pieces.note: Neon growths fold in from three edges and collide over a dark rift. Drag to seed a trail.

pieces.title: Missing Pixels
pieces.note: Horizontal grey bands punched with dark apertures that breathe and drift. Drag to open a missing pixel.

pieces.title: Twenty-Two Stripes
pieces.note: Exactly twenty two vertical stripes in eleven flat greys, requantized by a travelling glitch. Drag to scrub the glitch.

pieces.title: Ringcube
pieces.note: An open cube of twelve grey edge segments and eight joint rings, tumbling slowly. Drag to tumble the cube.

pieces.title: Grey as Difference
pieces.note: Identical grey tiles on different grey grounds read as different shades. Drag a tile to change its ground.

pieces.title: Plus Minus
pieces.note: A plus and a minus built from the same grey bars swap identities on a twelve second loop. Drag up for plus, down for minus.

pieces.title: Rig Divide
pieces.note: Seven rings of twelve flat segments, the northeast quadrant shifted outward on a slow breath. Drag to shift the quadrant.

pieces.title: Sortation Pass
pieces.note: A ten by ten field of flat colour quietly bubble sorts itself column by column. Drag to scrub the sort.

pieces.title: Quadrant Weave
pieces.note: Sixty four truchet tiles weave their arcs across a flat colour grid, rewritten by a travelling wave. Drag a tile to turn it.

pieces.title: Refraction Wedge
pieces.note: Eight striped rings turn under a mirrored ninety degree wedge that reverses the stripe order. Drag to aim the wedge.

pieces.title: Pixel Resolve
pieces.note: Flat circles and squares sample a blossom that resolves as the grid refines from coarse to fine. Drag to change the resolution.

pieces.title: Wormhole Study
pieces.note: Concentric bands of magenta, teal and amber fold inward toward a dark tunnel mouth. Drag to bend the tunnel.

pieces.title: Recursive Fold
pieces.note: Five levels of recursive folds rotate against each other in indigo, cyan and warm white. Drag to stir the folds.

pieces.title: Interference Bloom
pieces.note: Two wave systems cross on near black and bloom into ember and teal fringes that open and close. Drag to move the bloom.

pieces.title: Palette Breath
pieces.note: A domain warped gradient field drifts through ember, teal and magenta palette moods, one at a time. Drag to shift the weather.

pieces.title: Perfect Zoom
pieces.note: Twenty four nested squares scaled by the golden ratio dive inward in a seamless thirty second zoom. Drag to dive.

pieces.title: Ten Print Field
pieces.note: A grid of diagonal strokes forms a labyrinth that rewrites itself in a slow diagonal sweep. Drag to clear a path.

pieces.title: Subdivision Study
pieces.note: Golden-ratio subdivision, five levels: children grow from each divider.

pieces.title: Sphere Tiling
pieces.note: A wireframe sphere of latitude, longitude and icosahedron edges turns once a minute. Drag to turn the sphere.

pieces.title: Optics Engine
pieces.note: Forty eight black bars taper around a white circle on bright orange, reading as a spinning tunnel. Drag to spin the field.

pieces.title: Crater Study
pieces.note: Six rings of black and white bars radiate from a black core on vivid blue, reading as a deep crater. Drag to spin the field.

pieces.title: Rotorelief Loop
pieces.note: Forty eight black bars taper around a white centre on bright orange, turning as one rigid plate once every twenty four seconds. Drag to spin the field.

pieces.title: Flourish Field
pieces.note: Sixty four tapered black bars burst from an off-centre white disc on teal, with a single coral bar at the golden angle. Drag to spin the field.

pieces.title: Tunnel Run
pieces.note: Twenty four rounded squares in coral and cream rush toward the viewer on near black, accelerating as they grow. Press to speed the tunnel.

pieces.title: Dot Tide
pieces.note: A grid of indigo dots on warm white swells and shrinks as a diagonal wave rolls corner to corner. Drag to raise a second wave.

pieces.title: Primitive Ballet
pieces.note: Three boxes and two spheres in flat studio colours drift and turn on warm grey, bobbing on separate sine paths. Drag to orbit the mobile.

pieces.title: Kinetic Word
pieces.note: The word MOTION in a bold grotesque, each glyph pulsing in staggered sequence on cream before the whole word breathes. Drag to ripple the word.

pieces.title: Gyre Lines
pieces.note: Three plotter gyres on kraft, hundreds of spokes displaced into smooth organic outlines. Drag to turn a gyre.

pieces.title: Simple Grid Study
pieces.note: A hairline grid on kraft, flat at the corners and deeply warped at the centre like a pressed sheet. Drag to press the sheet.

pieces.title: Blurr Field
pieces.note: A monochrome pixel field blurred into soft topography and stepped into seven greys, hard square edges throughout. Drag to shift the field.

pieces.title: Oscillator Drift
pieces.note: Three sine oscillators on kraft modulate each other over a thirty second cycle, their sum traced below at double weight. Drag to set the modulation.

pieces.title: Flower Gradient
pieces.note: Four soft colour masses fuse and separate like a slow bloom, lilac, peach and rose cycling through one another. Drag to warp the bloom.

pieces.title: Gradient Weather
pieces.note: A dawn field of gold and dusty rose drifts edge to edge with no centre, weather made of colour alone. Drag to shift the weather.

pieces.title: Bloom Cycle
pieces.note: An eight petal bloom opens and closes on a twelve second breath, deep violet heart fading to cream tips. Drag to open the bloom.

pieces.title: Slate Drift
pieces.note: Muted teal aurora bands drift over ink in a night field, violet only where the light gathers. Drag to steer the drift.

pieces.title: Black Sand Drift
pieces.note: Rust and hide coloured masses gather on black sand, bone showing only as winding ridges around dark cores. Drag to lean the creatures.

pieces.title: Fossil Bed
pieces.note: A dark sedimentary slab with seven bone imprints pressed into its strata, lit from the upper left. Drag to move the light.

pieces.title: Tessellate
pieces.note: Forty voronoi cells wander on deep water, bone thin edges, only the largest cells filled with rust. Drag to add a point.

pieces.title: Intangible Mass
pieces.note: A ridged dark mass looms under a black void while a soft beam sweeps and breathes across it. Drag to aim the light.

pieces.title: Single Curve
pieces.note: One unbroken line, six thousand steps of it, coiling and looping across paper without ever lifting. Drag to spin the drawing.

pieces.title: Grid Rule
pieces.note: Four hundred marks placed by one pure index rule, no randomness anywhere, blooming from a quiet centre. Drag to move the bloom.

pieces.title: Emberfall
pieces.note: Sweeping diagonal bands of bronze strokes flow across black, each band traced by one glowing ember edge line. Drag to bend the flow.

pieces.title: Palindrome
pieces.note: One hundred forty stroked circles from an off-centre origin, coloured by a mirrored palette that turns slowly with no seam. Drag to move the center.

pieces.title: Cellfield
pieces.note: A polar mosaic disc of 432 cells where warm and cool fields churn against each other like weather. Drag to pull the warm field.

pieces.title: Threadbands
pieces.note: Seven diagonal bands of string art tangle on warm paper, colour flowing from burnt orange to indigo. Drag to stir the threads.

pieces.title: Phaseflame
pieces.note: Two hundred twenty columns of short segments rise as layered phase flames in red, orange and cream on deep blue. Drag to lean the flames.

pieces.title: Driftsquare
pieces.note: One square stroked four hundred times, drifting and twisting into a ribbon of pure moire density. Drag to scrub the drift.

pieces.title: Topomembrane
pieces.note: A membrane of nine thousand points rippling over two hidden knots, steep contours glowing amber on deep teal. Drag to press the membrane.

pieces.title: Shiftweave
pieces.note: Horizontal bands of red, black and cream shifted row by row into woven chevrons, rendered in chunky pixels. Drag to deepen the weave.

pieces.title: Grassline
pieces.note: A thicket grown from vector strokes alone, root-dense and sparse at the tips, sprouting forever. Drag to blow the wind.

pieces.title: Monolith Study
pieces.note: Two regimes trading places: a chaotic line garden dissolving into a single dark monolith, then back again. Drag to trade garden for stone.

pieces.title: Weight of Process
pieces.note: Hundreds of ellipses in only three stroke weights tangle into ecosystems on warm paper, red fog settling where it pleases. Drag to gather the ellipses.

pieces.title: Rule Weather
pieces.note: A grid of orbiting dots pushed off course by a slow diagonal wave, the interference glowing amber where it runs strong. Drag to gust the field.

pieces.title: Hashed Arcs
pieces.note: An eight by eight grid of precise arcs with exactly one thing wrong, a single red disruption that migrates every twenty seconds. Tap a cell to break it.

pieces.title: Daily Lines
pieces.note: One line study a day, drawn slowly in ink, with the last seven days fading behind it as ghosts. Drag to scan the week.

pieces.title: Rayhatch Co-create
pieces.note: A soft raymarched form described entirely by hatch lines, shaped by three invisible zones along the bottom strip. Drag the lower strip to shape it.

pieces.title: 512 Characters
pieces.note: A whole raymarched world generated by one formula of 308 characters, the code itself printed live beneath the terrain it describes. Drag the world to scrub time.

pieces.title: Summit Circle
pieces.note: Twelve drawing agents share one canvas, each with its own hand, politely avoiding each other's wet ink. Drag to join the session.

pieces.title: Free Mint
pieces.note: A calm field of drifting strokes where every touch gifts a small unique edition that drifts off to join your collection wall. Touch and lift to mint an edition.

pieces.title: The Crescent Shore
pieces.note: A reaction-diffusion field grows live from a small seed: spots near one shore of the crescent, worms mid-way, coral labyrinths at the far end, in duotone ink on warm paper. Drag to scrub the shore.

pieces.title: The Proxy
pieces.note: An invisible dipole field on black, revealed only by thousands of tiny filings that align, chain and clump into nested arcs, voids and strays. Drag a pole to bend the field.

pieces.title: Gather
pieces.note: A slime-mold swarm on warm paper weaves angular trails into reticulated networks that rebuild around every disc stamped into them. Hold to gather, release to stamp.

pieces.title: Shader Room
pieces.note: Three ghost collaborators type live shader code in a dark editor while the chrome torus knot below morphs with every edit they make. Drag to scrub the rehearsal.

pieces.title: Forty-Two Lines
pieces.note: A fantasy editor that refuses a forty-third line of code, auto-correcting every attempt into a comment while its isometric preview world turns below. Drag to scroll the code.

pieces.title: Hex House Study
pieces.note: A brutalist mansion of rounded blocks assembles itself in a black void, chrome edges, one amber window, then holds under a slow orbit. Drag to orbit the house.

pieces.title: Spider Diamonds
pieces.note: Five crystalline gem spiders drift in a dark void, a slow pulse of light travelling through the cluster from the largest outward. Drag to turn the cluster.

pieces.title: Olympic Form
pieces.note: A single bone white contour of an athlete's body melts into a letter, holds, and melts into the next, spelling her name one glyph at a time. Drag to scrub the letters.

pieces.title: Cursor Bloom
pieces.note: One arrow cursor multiplies into a comet trail of cursors drawing fading ribbons that thicken into blooms where they linger. Touch to become the fifth cursor.

pieces.title: NPC Intermission
pieces.note: A blocky NPC works tiny DJ decks in a dark club void, deadpan dialogue typing above while shader patterns pulse behind. Drag across the decks to scratch.

pieces.title: Twist Weave Screen
pieces.note: A screen of interlocking blue paper twists on the silver grid, negative space breathing between them as a folding ripple crosses and returns inverted. Watch only: it weaves itself.

pieces.title: Seven Corrugation
pieces.note: A modular paper surface of seven pointed stars in low relief while the light slowly orbits and shadows swing through the valleys. Watch only: the light does the folding.

pieces.title: Goodman Strauss Sevens
pieces.note: An endless field of silver grey rhombs in the seven fold Goodman Strauss tiling, one in seven dim violet at the substitution centres. Drag to subdivide the field.

pieces.title: Precipice
pieces.note: A quasicrystal field of golden rhombs at five flat heights, sudden dark cliffs where the levels displace, rising and sinking in a slow travelling wave. Watch only: it is a crystal thinking.

pieces.title: Eleven Nine Segment
pieces.note: Nine and eleven pointed paper stars in a dense field, every other petal lifted so the planes intersect and shadow each other. Drag to turn the field.

pieces.title: Two Fold Hexagon
pieces.note: A paper square on a dark surface draws two diagonal folds, collapses through the split mountain, and cuts free a glowing hexagon. Watch only: a magic trick.

pieces.title: Emblem Almond Ring
pieces.note: The eight pointed Emblem star tiled as an almond ring of cream die-cut modules, positives and mirror negatives alternating in a five by five field. Drag to flip the rows.

pieces.title: Sinan Rings
pieces.note: A paper disc scored with twelve fold rings that lift out of the plane in sequence as you drag, light falling through the cuts. Drag to make the cut.

pieces.title: Sinan's Rings
pieces.note: A white paper hexagon unfolds by true twelve fold replication into Sinan's ring, cut lines in deep ink blue, fold lines in red, the wedge geometry still visible at the centre. Watch only: the fold becomes the pattern.

pieces.title: Dual Level Five
pieces.note: A five fold rosette in green ink over red construction arcs, the compass circles never hidden, with a second level of relationships threading through the motifs. Drag to scrub between the levels.

pieces.title: Ninety Over Six
pieces.note: A ninety degree corner divided into six rays blooms into six fold rosettes across a square and root three grid, one tile in twelve burnt orange. Drag to change the division.

pieces.title: Polygonal Erasure
pieces.note: A grey octagon square tessellation draws itself, then a second pattern threads its midpoints and the base erases, leaving only the braided interlace. Watch only: the method is the piece.

pieces.title: Five Is Forbidden
pieces.note: A six fold field tiles perfectly with its unit cell outlined once, then a five fold attempt fails to repeat and relaxes into quasiperiodic order, the mismatch points glowing dim violet. Watch only: the failure is the lesson.

pieces.title: Topkapi Correction
pieces.note: A published rosette with two petals slightly off, in faded tan, then red construction lines arrive and pull it true, the corrected pattern drawing itself in indigo over the old. Drag to scrub the correction.

pieces.title: Kündekâri Wings
pieces.note: Interlocking wooden star lattice from the Süleymaniye window wings, no nails, warm wood against dark while a slow light orbits and shadows swing through the joints. Watch only: the joinery is the piece.

pieces.title: Surmadan Twelve
pieces.note: The twelve fold Surmadan unit cell from the Niksar stone carving, built in sixteen construction steps from a divided rectangle to the full tiled field. Drag to walk the steps.

pieces.title: Delete the Base
pieces.note: Bonner's five moves performed on tracing paper: the octagon square grid draws, midpoints mark in red, rays grow at the median angle, then the base deletes itself entirely and the ribbons braid. Watch only: the deletion is the climax.

pieces.title: Acute, Median, Obtuse
pieces.note: One octagon square panel, three ray modes: acute, median and obtuse grow three different star families from the same grid. Tap to change the mode.

pieces.title: Seven and Fourteen
pieces.note: A seven and fourteen fold star field in marble and Persian turquoise, one great fourteen pointed star at the centre, sevens orbiting, subdividing outward forever without ever repeating. Watch only: it zooms into itself.

pieces.title: The Puzzling Unstructured
pieces.note: A coarse pencil grid, wide black ribbons over it, fine red stars nested at the intersections, then the coarse grid deletes and the pattern stands puzzlingly unstructured, its ghost breathing back now and then. Watch only.

pieces.title: Eleven and Thirteen
pieces.note: Eleven pointed and thirteen pointed stars interleaved in one nonsystematic field, black straps on paper, the two folds reading as twin constellations. Drag to scrub the contact offset and watch the stars breathe.

pieces.title: Follow the Ribbon
pieces.note: A braided cedar panel where one amazonite ribbon winds through the whole field, entering bottom left and leaving top right, splitting into twin strands halfway and rejoining. Watch only: follow the ribbon.

pieces.title: Polygons in Contact
pieces.note: Hankin's polygons in contact: a pencil tiling with small stars blooming inside each tile and linking across the boundaries into one tapestry. Tap to change the tiling family.

pieces.title: Not a Quasicrystal
pieces.note: A near fivefold star field that looks quasiperiodic, ten pointed stars scattered like the Darb-i Imam shrine, but secretly a perfectly regular decagon and bowtie tessellation underneath. Tap to X-ray the hidden grid.

pieces.title: Najm Rosette
pieces.note: Kaplan's two step engine performed live: a hexagonal scaffold draws, eight pointed rosettes bloom and interlace, then the scaffold fades to nothing and the finished star field stands unsupported, one gold rosette at its heart. Watch only.

pieces.title: Zellij Skeleton
pieces.note: A freeform zellij skeleton of eight pointed stars and shuttle safts in cobalt, emerald, white and ochre, grout between every tile, composed fresh each time. Tap to reseed a new composition.

pieces.title: Strange Loop (Five Colours)
pieces.note: Squares hinged at their corners open and close like a breathing lattice, map coloured in exactly five colours, neighbours never matching, while the plane rotates so the central square sits perfectly still. Watch only: a strange loop.

pieces.title: Parquet Drift
pieces.note: A horizontal strip where a square grid melts into a rhomb tiling, every intermediate column a legal tiling, vertex by vertex at glacial speed. Watch only: the slowness is the piece.

pieces.title: Hat Tile Field
pieces.note: A patch of the aperiodic hat monotile, every tile carrying the same small eight pointed star in neon line on near black, one tile in forty signal orange, drifting almost imperceptibly so the non repetition can sink in. Watch only.

pieces.title: Dichromatic Garden
pieces.note: An Ishihara field of red and green dots with a large eight pointed star hidden in the colour confusion channel, invisible until you tap the eye and the simulated deuteranope view lets it resolve. Tap the eye to switch views.

pieces.title: Absolute Rosette
pieces.note: The same eight fold rosette in two universes: flat and still on the left, bent into a Poincare disc on the right where it turns slowly and shrinks toward the boundary in endless regression. Watch only.

pieces.title: Beyond the Great Star
pieces.note: A colossal 96 pointed star in gold line on deep blue, rings of motifs stepping down in size as they grow outward until the rim dissolves into tiny stars, turning a quarter turn per loop. Watch only.

pieces.title: Ripple Emergence
pieces.note: Concentric ripples on black, copied at a third scale around themselves generation after generation until a Koch curve stands visible across the field, though no line was ever drawn. Watch only.

pieces.title: Spiral Bloom Tessellation
pieces.note: Kite tiles grouped into self similar spirals, strictly two coloured lapis and bone, until knot lines trace over the edges and the tile outlines fade to nothing, leaving an infinite interwoven spiral design. Tap to reseed a new arrangement.

pieces.title: Infinity Strand
pieces.note: One copper strand on black draws itself into a trefoil, then smaller copies grow inside its loops, five generations of a single unbroken knot. Watch only.

pieces.title: Self-Organizing Swarm
pieces.note: Small triangles, squares and hexagons in OpArt primaries sit in neat clusters until you drag through them; they scatter, drift back and re cluster into tilings on their own. Drag to scatter, double tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Plastic Spiral Moth
pieces.note: Interlocking spirals on the plastic number fill a black field, and at the centre of the largest a moth fades in, its wings built from the same spiral geometry, dust shimmering before everything dims. Watch only.

pieces.title: Paper Tree
pieces.note: One small branch cluster stamped smaller at every tip, rotated, reflected and lightened, until the envelope reads as a fractal tree in black ink on warm paper. Double tap for a new tree.

pieces.title: Groovy Hyperbolic Field
pieces.note: A violet relief field growing exponentially outward, grooves like cactus ribs catching light from one side; drag and the light swings, and the grooves sweep through highlight and shadow. Drag to move the light.

pieces.title: Fractal Reptile Garden
pieces.note: X pentominoes iterated into fractal reptiles, each subdivided into five smaller copies of itself, tiling the plane with no gaps in blue, bone and copper, generation by generation. Watch only.

pieces.title: Hierarchical Draw
pieces.note: Trilobite and cross tiles in ink on bone white, indigo on one side and rust on the other, their markings forcing a lattice of squares that doubles, and doubles again, drawn in generation by generation. Tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Quotient Bloom
pieces.note: A vivid wallpaper pattern spreads edge to edge, then folds: symmetric points draw together along lighting mirror lines until the whole design collapses into one small folded jewel, holds, and unfolds again. Watch only.

pieces.title: Light Organ 24
pieces.note: The 24 cell drawn as arcs of light, stereographically projected; each lighting state recolours the edges into a different sub symmetry of the whole. Drag rotates the projection in 4D, tap advances the state.

pieces.title: Kogame Curvature
pieces.note: A woven field of paper strips in seven colours, over under over in the kogame pattern; where the triangular holes have five sides the weaving cups up, six lie flat, seven flare hyperbolic. Drag to change the holes under your finger, tap to reshuffle the colours.

pieces.title: One of N
pieces.note: Steel tube segments lie in a jumble around an invisible cube; drag them end to end and snap one continuous tube that threads every octant exactly once. When the rule holds, a gold line traces the whole path. Drag to build, double tap to scatter.

pieces.title: Quarter Turn
pieces.note: A twisting lattice with coloured nodes whose colours may only ever cycle red to yellow to green to blue and back; no other permutation is allowed, and none ever appears. Tap to turn the crank one quarter.

pieces.title: Hat Field
pieces.note: The hat tiling grown by substitution from a single hat at the centre, superclusters blooming outward into an aperiodic sea of greens and blues, the mirror image hats picked out in yellow. Tap to grow a different tiling.

pieces.title: Tooti Tooti
pieces.note: Handmade paper tiles cut from an envelope, fold lines and all; drag them edge to edge and they grow into a symmetric pattern whose symmetry the envelope chose. Close a full ring and the axes flash indigo. Drag to place, double tap for a new envelope.

pieces.title: Gravity Light
pieces.note: A wall of twenty four acrylic tubes where pulses of light are real bouncing balls, falling, accelerating, decaying bounce by bounce, cooling from white to amber as their energy fades. Drag to tilt gravity, tap to drop in a new ball.

pieces.title: The Jiggle
pieces.note: A massive steel space filling curve in a cube, seven hundred pounds of it, that slowly redraws itself as a different valid path, then ripples with a jiggle that takes seconds to settle. Drag to swing it and feel the weight.

pieces.title: Crank Cut
pieces.note: A crankshaft turning at exactly the correct rate drives a cutting torch that lays one steel coil per revolution, stacking into a double triamond, until hexastix rods slide through the gyroid behind it and the two sculptures interlock. Tap to slow the rig.

pieces.title: Mock Back
pieces.note: A creature of rusted plates and rebar with a funnel ear, asleep with an ember breathing in its chest; it stirs, listens, and plays back its little repertoire transformed, lights tracing its ribs. Drag to tilt its head, tap to make it perform.

pieces.title: Forty-Five Foot Worm
pieces.note: A forty five foot ferrocement worm crawling in place across warm paper, forty segments rippling head to tail, every tenth painted weathered red. Drag along its body to conduct the peristalsis; tap a red segment and it tucks, shy, then relaxes.

pieces.title: Smash Frame
pieces.note: A water balloon, a powder egg and a piece of fruit hang in a row in a dark studio. Tap one and the bat swings; at the instant of impact time dilates to near stop while thin white lines diagram the collision, force vectors, shock rings, fracture maps, then time releases and the mess falls. Drag to aim.

pieces.title: Numbered Sections
pieces.note: A dancing boar arrives unfinished, as twelve numbered steel sections scattered around its silhouette. Drag each section home; only its own slot accepts it, with a soft clunk flash. Assemble all twelve and the boar rears up and dances for twenty seconds. Double tap to scatter it again.

pieces.title: Push a Hundred Times
pieces.note: One big steel and rubber button in the dark, with a single ring of light. It does nothing until you push it, and then everything: ripples, then arcs of light bouncing off the edges of the world, then a full cascade, escalating with every press and never punishing a masher. Leave it alone and it presses itself, demonstrating.

pieces.title: FRESH FISH CRATE
pieces.note: A fish built from fourteen stacked steel layers, gold at the front where the heat took it, rust red at the fins, swimming as a topographic contour map; it arrives in a stenciled wooden crate whose lid swings away. Drag to pull the layers apart into their contour set; double tap for a different fish.

pieces.title: Mock Back
pieces.note: Maude, a bird of hot pink, teal and yellow flat blocks with an aluminum belly, perched over five little worm stations. Tap a worm to speak; she mocks your tap pattern back transformed, then answers with a stranger's older phrase from her memory. Double tap her for a scrambled greatest hits.

pieces.title: Bike-Chain Fur
pieces.note: Sassy the Sasquatch, eleven feet of her, her fur woven from thousands of interlocking bike chain links combed over her body. Drag across her to part the fur; it ripples like chainmail and settles back heavy. Every forty five seconds the scene darkens, and at full dark her blue eyes bloom.

pieces.title: Brake-Light Wings
pieces.note: A monarch whose wings are a mosaic of domed brake light red and turn signal amber panels over a steel vein frame. She beats her wings slowly; light drifts across the domes; then hail cracks three panels, and they are repaired one by one, re glossed. Drag a wing tip to tilt her.

pieces.title: Peroxide
pieces.note: A plasma cut steel carp tail and a peroxide brush. Drag the brush across the tail and rust blooms along your stroke, spreading and darkening over the next minute, bloom to mature rust to deep umber. Double tap for a fresh tail, the next trophy.

pieces.title: Crush
pieces.note: A twelve foot man built from bike parts, chainring hips, spoke ribs, chain spine, whose open torso is a recycling hopper. Tap to toss a can into him; every fifth can triggers the crush, torso folding in, cans bursting to flecks. Drag his arm to aim the next throw.

pieces.title: Panther Prowl
pieces.note: A Florida panther that assembles itself from forty numbered steel plates, each landing with a white blue weld flash, stands in a prowl with gold heat accents on its flanks, then comes apart again. Drag while it stands and its head tracks your finger.

pieces.title: Worm Friends' Chorus
pieces.note: Maude's worm friends on their own stage: nine dim green worms in a loose field, each holding a phrase of up to eight notes. Tap a worm to feed it notes; it loops them back at its own tempo, every replayed note an expanding ripple, all nine drifting in and out of phase. Double tap clears a voice. One worm is a stranger and plays gold.

pieces.title: Artificial Spirit
pieces.note: A creature sewn together from discards: worn fabric swatches, a leather patch, glass bead eyes, one arm that clearly belonged to a different toy. It lives by four toy verbs, jiggle, shuffle, squeak, recoil, cycling them in random order. Drag on it and it recoils from your hand; drag gently near it and it shuffles closer.

pieces.title: Heat Gun
pieces.note: A brine shrimp of clear heat welded plastic, its membrane stretched over a darker inner body you can see through the skin, weld seams bright along every edge. It drifts and paddles slowly. Drag anywhere and your finger is the heat gun: the membrane bulges toward it, softened, then cools back to shape over eight seconds. Double tap for a different creature.

pieces.title: Tun State
pieces.note: A tardigrade in muted amber, ambling on clawed legs. Leave it alone for twenty seconds and it presses pause: legs fold, body wrinkles and collapses into the dark tun, a dehydrated blob that pulses faintly, still alive, waiting. Tap and it rehydrates, plumps back to amber and walks again.

pieces.title: Instant Life
pieces.note: Sammy at sixteen feet: a monumental brine shrimp that does not fit the frame, translucent membrane over a segmented body, swimming upside down as brine shrimp do. The view drifts slowly along its length, eleven leg pairs paddling in travelling waves; drag to slide the window toward the head or the tail.

pieces.title: Twisted Landscape
pieces.note: A dreamscape relief of seven twisted aluminum sheets: cave hollow, flying ridge, river cut, grass in fine strokes, readable from several viewpoints at once. Drag sideways to fan the layers apart like a deck; drag down to pinch them together. Release and it settles into a new distortion, never the original. Double tap for another landscape.

pieces.title: Message Wall
pieces.note: Three amber tardigrade vessels resting under a reef wall of glowing marks. Tap anywhere to contribute: your mark blooms and drifts up into the wall, and the nearest vessel pulses, its glow shifting toward your hue. The wall remembers the whole session. Double tap clears it for the next thousand messages.

pieces.title: Jiggle Choir
pieces.note: Five small patchwork creatures, each running the toy verbs on its own clock: jiggle, shuffle, squeak, recoil, desynchronized like a choir warming up. Every so often they all squeak at once. Their tempo follows the time of day, lively at midday, drowsy at night. Tap one for a solo; drag through them to scatter the choir.

pieces.title: In Need of Love
pieces.note: A small hunched creature of worn cloth, one limb too long, eyes slightly mismatched, alone in a large dark field. It flinches. Fast hands make it recoil and hunch tighter; a slow, gentle drag across its back soothes it, warmth blooming through its fabric, until at full trust it uncurls, leans into the touch, and does its one soft jiggle of contentment. Double tap for another.

pieces.title: Tele-Present
pieces.note: A field of about one hundred twenty six dried stalks, all leaning the same way at the same moment, because none of them is deciding: a single remote wind sensor drives them all, its little mechanism twitching in the corner a beat before the field answers. The weather changes every minute or so. Drag to throw a local gust through them.

pieces.title: Station 46246
pieces.note: A lattice of wooden rods on near invisible threads, rippling as one wave passes through it: a simulated NOAA buoy reports height and period, and each rod answers the same wave a fraction later than its neighbour. Every minute the sea state changes; about every three minutes the buoy goes missing for five seconds and the lattice settles, waiting. Tap to call the next sea state early.

pieces.title: Fly Brain
pieces.note: On warm paper, a glass sphere of about a hundred houseflies, and beside it a sheet where a small red carriage carves what the flies do: a lone fly draws a hairline, a dense cluster gouges thick, the carriage following the swarm's centroid. After three minutes the sheet scrolls away intact and a fresh one starts. Double tap inside the sphere for new flies and a new sheet.

pieces.title: Sky Scroll
pieces.note: A ballpoint plotter drawing the sky on warm paper: hatch strokes dense where the clouds are thick, dissolving to bare paper at the edges, the little red nib working back and forth in bands for about twenty five seconds a drawing. Then the scroll advances, the finished sky slides into the stack below, and a new sky begins. Double tap to advance early.

pieces.title: Debris Sun
pieces.note: Fifty twigs in the dark, all leaning exactly the same way, tracking the oldest piece of space debris currently above the horizon from a small catalog of 1958 to 1972 objects, its position a tiny dim amber point high in the frame. When it sets, every twig lowers to rest and waits for the next oldest to rise. Double tap to advance.

pieces.title: Night Pilot
pieces.note: A plant is the pilot: two slow noise channels from its leaves steer a drone through the night, and its amber light draws a long exposure trail that fades over twenty five seconds, the drawing always half dissolved. When the trail is gone the drone hovers, then a new plant takes over. Double tap for a new plant; drag near the drone to nudge it off course for a moment.

pieces.title: Antipode
pieces.note: A pink foam relief of the place on earth exactly opposite this gallery, clouds and ocean swells carved as miniature topography under raking light, two older carvings leaning beside it. It is still, as carvings are. Every fifty seconds a new antipode is carved and the old one joins the stack. Drag across it and your finger presses the foam, leaving a deeper trail that stays on that carving. Double tap to carve a new one now.

pieces.title: If/Then
pieces.note: Two identical little machines with camera eyes, courting across the dark on a strict if then grammar: seek, detect, a thin green box snapping round the partner labelled mate with a climbing confidence, approach, almost touch at ninety seven percent, then a quick retreat, and seeking again. Each courtship makes the next approach a little bolder. Drag one aside and it reorients and resumes.

pieces.title: Machine Quartet
pieces.note: Four machines drawing on warm paper, each by its own rule: a jittered random walk, a Lissajous, a curl noise drift, a decaying orbit, pens never lifting, old ink fading over a minute. Every twenty seconds a convergence pulls all four to one invisible point and the lines braid for five seconds before scattering back to their rules. Drag near a thread and it follows your hand for three seconds.

pieces.title: Stitched Maps
pieces.note: A quilting machine stitching maps on muslin: precise indigo contour lines following a noise field, drawn on stitch by dashed stitch from left to right, and over them a hand layer in madder, looser, jittered, knotting where it crosses. When the map completes it holds, then a new one begins. The machine never stops.

pieces.title: Chance Cloud
pieces.note: A pointillist field of ink dots on warm gray paper, each holding a little energy, sharing it with its neighbours, fading when it runs dry. Clusters bloom where energy concentrates and dissolve where it drains; a few rust dots mark the high energy survivors. Nothing is random static: it is an ecology of chance, converging and going extinct on a thirty second breath.

pieces.title: Telegraph
pieces.note: A ghost typist at a telegraph: short strange phrases in phosphor amber, typed character by character with an irregular rhythm, held a moment, then each letter jitters and crumbles into falling dots, dissolving like sand. Between phrases, Morse like pulses blink dim green along the bottom edge. Tap to reseed the phrase source.

pieces.title: Generator Fugue
pieces.note: McTavish's swarm made visible as a pipeline: a cyan particle stream flows left to right through four small labelled stations, generate, filter, transform, render. The filter culls and leaves magenta residue; the transformer turns the survivors; the renderer deposits warm yellow marks that accumulate into a drawing on the right, fading over ninety seconds. Drag across the stream to inject a burst.

pieces.title: Blue Atlas Scroll
pieces.note: A long scroll of thin Prussian blue line drawings on paper white: coastline contours, a railway with its stations, a small bird with a suitcase, equations and text fragments that dissolve as they pass. Nothing filled, nothing shaded. It drifts slowly left, seamlessly; drag to scrub through the atlas yourself.

pieces.title: Messy Desk
pieces.note: A messy desk on kraft paper: note cards, printout fragments, arrows, coffee rings, a highlighter yellow sticky or two, all deliberate clutter. A wandering reader cursor underlines fragments and ties the last few together with red thread, then redraws its thinking. Drag the fragments and they snap back elastically, unless the thread holds them.

pieces.title: Resonance Field
pieces.note: Three or four ripple centres drift out of phase on near black ground, their concentric rings crossing into moire, small warm glyphs orbiting each centre like buffers of found sound made visible. It is her chance sound drawn instead of heard: a pure watch piece with no interaction at all.

pieces.title: Crash Stripes
pieces.note: Kluber's origin crash, frozen: thin horizontal bands of lime and charcoal on near white, heights set by a seeded sequence, a column of narrower stripes at the far left. One band glitches: it stutters, doubles, flashes cyan for a beat, then settles, re-firing every nine to fourteen seconds on its own schedule, never on a click. Flat colour only, no gradients, no error dialogs. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Split Infinitives
pieces.note: Three densities of orange on yellow: sixty four tight dark orange lines at left, twenty eight looser stripes at centre, sixty four at right, a deep orange band bisecting the middle. Over the paint, one additive wash of white gold light drifts left and right on two incommensurable periods, forty seven and seventy one seconds, so the composite never repeats in a sitting. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Never the Same Twice
pieces.note: Teal, dark teal and chartreuse stripes hold perfectly still while four independent light layers play over them: a warm wash drifting sideways, a cool wash rising and sinking, a narrow travelling light rectangle, a slow scanline flicker. Their periods are primes, thirty seven, fifty three, sixty one, eighty nine seconds, so the whole state effectively never repeats. The painting never moves. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Melt Together
pieces.note: Orange, yellow and teal lines above and below a central teal green band filled with fragmented orange geometry, after Friday I'm in Love. One slow diagonal luminance wave crosses every forty seconds, desynced from the painted edges, so band edges seem to shift colour while the paint never moves. You cannot tell which colours are painted and which are projected. That is the piece. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Burning Year
pieces.note: A square relief of twenty four by twenty four cells, each split into four triangles, coloured in hard stepped bands from neon green through yellow and orange to deep red on near black, after the 3D printed Burning Year. The relief never changes shape; only the light moves, a slow sun orbiting over ninety seconds, shading each facet and dragging a specular streak across. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Parsing the Lingo
pieces.note: The one Kluber you may touch: wide turquoise and chartreuse bands around a big central rectangle of ninety fine blue and green lines on deep blue, an optical field like data made visible. Drag across it and the lines scramble locally under your finger, then spring back to order over about four seconds. At rest a faint data shimmer runs through them. The piece heals itself.

pieces.title: Radio Free Santa Fe
pieces.note: Lime and cyan stripes full bleed, warm yellow green along the top and bottom edges, and six blocks of orange and violet interrupting the flow, three left, three right. Each block breathes on its own prime period clock, twenty three, thirty one, forty seven, fifty nine seconds, a slow inhale and exhale of opacity, never a blink. No antennas, no waves: the title is the only nod to radio. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Slow Mathematics
pieces.note: The quietest Kluber: thin black and light blue stripes on paper, split two fifths to three, one solid black band cutting across the bottom third. A single red line redraws itself continuously along the stripe boundaries, one edge at a time, a full pass every seventy five seconds. Tap to reseed its path; the page never reloads, the line just starts a new proof.

pieces.title: Pulse
pieces.note: Woodfill's parking garage pulse: nine rows of sixty square lamp dots across near black, rows offset half a dot so the chase drifts diagonal. Brightness travels in long packets, rows lighting in sequence, holding, releasing; sometimes two packets cross and interfere instead of cancelling. Flat light only: these are on and off devices, no glow, no atmosphere. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Cocktail Party
pieces.note: Five bare mechanisms sharing a dark stage: a pendulum bar, a bulb bouncing on its cord, a wheel rolling a circular track, a whirling fan vane, a metronome arm, mounts and wires all exposed. Each keeps its own period, seven, eleven, thirteen, seventeen, twenty three seconds, so every few minutes they near align for one beat, acknowledge each other, and drift apart again. A cocktail party for electronic nerds. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Shadows Variable
pieces.note: Flat wood tone panels, bars, triangles, one disc, one safety orange accent, drifting and turning slowly on a pale wall. Two fixed lamps off frame throw long hard shadows to the lower right; the shadows lag a beat and a half behind the panels and stretch as a panel nears its lamp. The shadows are the second artwork. The lamps never move; the world does. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Honest Signals
pieces.note: Ninety six semaphore flags on thin poles, white and signal red, each holding one of four orientations. A seeded message propagates through the field as waves of flips; then noise creeps in, spurious flips rising until the pattern is unreadable, until a call and response sweep reasserts the honest signal and the noise floor resets. Tap reseeds the message.

pieces.title: Ladder Ladder
pieces.note: A ladder built out of small ladders: every rung a tiny ladder, every rail a stack of them, clamped and bolted at every joint, provisional as a workshop thought. Drag any mini ladder and it pulls out of the assembly; let go and it springs home, the whole rig wobbling with the disturbance before it settles back into itself.

pieces.title: Training Models
pieces.note: A workshop shelf of boxy wood forms, birch, white and grey with exactly one green accent box, alive in stop motion: every half second they snap to neighbouring grid cells with a two pixel handmade jitter, rotations only ever in fifteen degree steps. No tweening, no easing. Drag may nudge one off its cell; on release it re-enters the walk.

pieces.title: Seeing the Night Bluely
pieces.note: Yesterday's sky, broadcast tonight: a wide horizon band of forty colour strata sampled from one day's arc, dawn amber through noon pale to dusk violet, drifting almost imperceptibly over a dark field, one thin registration line marking the tower. A full day plays over six minutes, holds night for thirty seconds, then restarts with different weather. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Deluxe Unit
pieces.note: Woodfill's rolling deluxe unit: a plywood tower on casters, speaker cones below, tiny green and red status LEDs, and a sign panel up top rotating ninety degrees every eight seconds through its glyphs, circle, triangle, bar, X. Each glyph change kicks the speaker cones with a visible pulse. The whole unit rolls a slow small circle on the dark floor, casters swivelling with the direction. Silent, despite the speakers. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Blue Punch
pieces.note: A blue scaffold crushed into a V shaped gorge in Ladakh: packed so dense the poles interpenetrate and the top mass bulges like it is about to burp, the log fills stacked in threes, smaller as they climb. The whole mass breathes on a twenty second loop, tightening and brightening, then relaxing dim. Dust motes drift. A blue punch that pops out of the landscape. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Cocktail at Midnight
pieces.note: One hot pink scaffold bay in a dark storefront window at midnight, the exact pink of her title, #FF0080. A slow wave of brightness travels across the bays over fifteen seconds, full pink to dim and back, while the window glass throws faint vertical reflection streaks below. Flat colour, no neon glow, no signage. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Stoically Itself
pieces.note: A white scaffold in a white room, drawn so pale it nearly dissolves into the walls. The real subject is its shadows: long grey webs cast across the floor and walls by one orbiting stage light, stretching, crossing and reforming over thirty seconds while the structure itself never moves, and fading a touch more transparent as its shadows lengthen. Watch-only.

pieces.title: The Collapse
pieces.note: A pink scaffold fallen in a white salt desert, poles splayed, one corner still upright. Over forty five seconds it puts itself back together, bay by bay with a little overshoot wobble, stands whole for five seconds, then drops again in three, staggered, and rests. Resilience and resurrection in its bones. No debris, no drama. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Scaffold Configuration No. 7
pieces.note: Five to seven little nickel steel scaffold maquettes clustered in a black room, lit from one side, throwing webs of interlacing shadow across all four walls. The light drifts on a forty second loop and the shadow webs breathe apart and together; the maquettes themselves never move. You feel Gulliver sized looking down at them. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Secretariat Study
pieces.note: A hard edge abstraction of the Chandigarh Secretariat in graphite on paper: stacked slabs and a brise soleil grid, every line admirably straight but hand drawn, wobbling one or two percent off true, with a pale embossed ghost of the same geometry offset beside it. Strictly monochrome. Tap to reseed a new abstraction of the same building grammar.

pieces.title: Mineral Spirits
pieces.note: A golden scaffold standing in a dark abandoned hotel lobby in Astoria, four bays wide and rising past the top of the frame, dust hanging in diagonal light shafts from the upper right. The shafts drift on a thirty five second loop, the gold breathes, forty dust motes wander. After Bawa's 2016 installation in the vacant Astor Hotel. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Sets of Three
pieces.note: A climbable blue scaffold stepping up a Ladakhi hillside in sets of three, each trio smaller than the last, deep blue against pale rock. The topmost trio sways gently in the wind. Drag across it and the poles bend aside on their springs and settle back; the system is the toy. Double tap reseeds the trio layout.

pieces.title: Lost Glacier
pieces.note: A digital horizon after A Sky for Henasku: pale sky, a white glacier band, dark rock, nothing else. Over thirty seconds the glacier thins and recedes upward, a meditation on a lost glacier, then restores. The sky band drifts almost imperceptibly. No objects, no text. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Day Five
pieces.note: Chospel's Day 5, presented as his learning log presents it: a lone figure on a rocky ridge under a huge looming dome, teal water glow everywhere, a hard red light raking the rocks from the left. The atmosphere breathes on a twenty second loop, light shafts drifting, the glow pulsing. The caption is his: Day 5. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Dandelion Ball
pieces.note: A dandelion seed head of pastel strands, blue, white and pink, on near black, a thin stem below. It sways gently and sheds the odd seed upward. Drag across it to shake: a burst of seeds lets go and drifts off, and the ball regrows its full head over ten seconds.

pieces.title: Chaos Poster
pieces.note: A violet graphic poster in his bomb poster template: one dome fragment emblematic at centre, churning smoke shapes behind it, museum label typography below, the single accent character for chaos at top right, one caption line at the bottom. One hue family only, purple on purple. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Hard Surface Mech
pieces.note: His Day 7 hard surface study: a chunky low poly mech with big yellow leg armour, green knee pads and pink orange piston feet, standing on a flat green plane under a dark sky, lit like a film still. It idles, plates shifting a few pixels, accents breathing. Drag to orbit it; the yaw carries inertia and settles.

pieces.title: Yeti Hunter
pieces.note: His first ZBrush sculpt, kept flat: an elderly yeti hunter's bust on black, long white beard, tattooed torso, dark robe, red sash and headwear, lit by one deep red spotlight that slowly arcs so the tattooed planes catch the light in sequence. Dust motes hang in the beam. Watch-only.

pieces.title: David from Ladakh
pieces.note: His joke, kept straight: a grey clay David bust with curly hair wearing a tall, slightly worn top hat, turning slowly on black, one full turn every twenty four seconds, warm rim light on the clay. Tap to reseed: a new hat tilt and a fresh variation in the curls.

pieces.title: Silhouette Signal
pieces.note: His Day 10 silhouette study: a chunky black mech mirrored top and bottom on dark teal, cyan lights dotted along its armour seams. The lights chase slowly along the seams; the reflection below runs the same chase a third of a second behind. No other colour exists here. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Glacier's Retreat
pieces.note: Tsepel's Disko Valley land work: a lime white hillside scored with a branching maze of low blue walls and rust iron rods, marking where the Parkachik and Drang Drung glaciers used to be. Blue is former ice; white is exposed earth. Over thirty five seconds the blue thins and retreats upslope, then the hillside restores itself. The work dismantles and reimagines itself. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Nambu Tide
pieces.note: Where Mountains Meet the Sea: five to seven hand woven nambu wool cones, off white with bold black stripes, hang over a warm sand floor dotted with white salt mounds. The cones sway almost imperceptibly, breathing tidal, and their shadows ripple outward across the sand in slow concentric rings. Shadow is the second artwork. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Path of Hope
pieces.note: The Path of Hope as the 1 by 4 metre chiffon banner reads: a winding trail of footprints in snow, heavy boots and light steps side by side, entering large in the foreground and curving up between dark rocky walls to distant blue peaks. The trail is a record, not an event: only a slow snowfall and a faint breathing of light move, over forty seconds. Watch-only.

pieces.title: River Shadow
pieces.note: Tsepel's Henasku canyon: layered rock strata left and right, and through the gorge floor the pale winding shadow of a river that no longer flows. The ghost channel breathes on a thirty second loop, widening, narrowing to a thread, widening again: a memory of flow, not water. Dust motes drift in the one warm light. No blue anywhere: it is a shadow, not a stream. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Chadar Balance
pieces.note: His chadar trek scrap porter: a small laden figure of rusted parts, glowing red headlamp, chain icicles dangling from the torso, jerrycan on its back, balanced high on tilted diamond plates of thin ice. The whole group sways a degree and a half on a twenty five second loop, chains swinging out of phase. A held breath. It never falls. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Winter Warrior
pieces.note: His 2022 bronze, monumental and still: a lone winter figure in heavy clothes and a big rounded fur hat, hands clasped, standing frontal on rough rock under a plain overcast sky. Almost nothing moves: a slow breathing rise and fall, and now and then a small wisp of breath fog. No pedestal, no turntable. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Factory Summit
pieces.note: His industrialization piece: a pale blue grey mountain with a dense little factory straddling its highest peak, tan blocks, towers, chimneys. Over forty seconds the smoke thickens and the factory creeps a little further across the ridge, then recedes and the peak is clean again. The mountain endures: the warning, not the catastrophe. Watch-only.

pieces.title: What Melts Does Not Stay
pieces.note: His Fremantle thesis in one frame: a glacial blue field at the top, a band of nambu stripes across the middle, sand below. Luminous particles leave the glacier edge, travel the full height along a gentle curve, and settle into white salt rings on the sand that expand, fade and renew. A glacier carries history; what melts in the Himalayas doesn't stay there. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Living Vessels
pieces.note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's Vessel at Likir: dozens of unfired clay vessels on stones in a dusty field under a low stone wall, each holding a hidden seed. Over about a minute the vessels weather, cracks spreading, surfaces darkening, and green shoots rise from the mouths. The piece never resets: time is the artist. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Nduku
pieces.note: After her Bedforms wall sculpture Nduku: ceramic shards, matte black spheres and curved brown panels hang in a wide rhythm on a white gallery wall, one shield fragment veined in tan raku. Drag through them and they swing on invisible mounts, shadows swinging with them, settling slowly back to stillness. Drag to disturb.

pieces.title: Bedforms
pieces.note: After Bedforms: a sediment field of ripples in warm clay browns, geology reading as skin, with a few vessel silhouettes half buried at the edges. Drag through it and the ripples dent like wet clay under a hand, relaxing slowly and never quite forgetting the touch. Drag to press the clay.

pieces.title: Interlock
pieces.note: After her interlocking raku sculpture: two matte ceramic forms holding each other on a warm empty ground, one black with tan crackle veining, one warm stoneware. Drag to pull the pair apart along their embrace; release and they settle back together, slow and soft, the veining denser where they meet. Drag to separate.

pieces.title: The Clouds That Kept Us Grounded
pieces.note: After her Leh sky forms: heavy burnished stoneware clouds rest low over a dark Ladakhi ground, from days of staring at the sky and hoping the clouds don't clear. They drift almost imperceptibly while the low sun breathes across their surfaces. No interaction: stillness is the point. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Rock That Was Once Rock
pieces.note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's rock-formation stoneware: craggy strata-banded vessels that read as both geology and pot, clay being rock ground down and given back its shape. Tap to turn the rock over: the silhouettes stay, the strata, iron seams and lichen re-form on another face. Tap to re-stratify.

pieces.title: Crackle
pieces.note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's naked raku: dark ceramic spheres and ovoids on a pale ground, each wrapped in its own crackle network in tan veining, dense where it cooled fast, sparse where it cooled slow. Tap to re-fire the kiln and every network re-forms. Tap to re-fire.

pieces.title: Negative Space
pieces.note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's line that it is not the vessel itself which is valued, but the negative space it holds: a ring of tall vessels stands near-silhouette in a dark room while a single slow light orbits, and the gaps and hollow mouths flare and dim in turn. The subject is the holes, not the pots. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Zigongo Bands
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's banded vessels: a pot in side profile stacked with flat bands of coral, cobalt and emerald divided by black zigzag lines, one cream band in the stack. The bands rise slowly as if the vessel is being pulled from clay while its belly breathes. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Crackle
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's crackle veil: a deep cobalt field grows a black craquelure network, each fresh crack carrying a faint hot edge out of the kiln before it cools matte. Drag across it for thermal shock and new cracks branch from your path; double-tap to re-glaze. Drag to crack, double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Target
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's hand-painted medallions: a wobbly spiral target in terracotta, cream and cobalt on a crackled cream ground, green bleeding in at the rim, drawn stroke by stroke, ring by ring, the ochre spiral last. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Smoke Resist
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's wax-resist raku firing: a cream vessel on near-black, smoke streaming across it and laying soot everywhere except where you have painted wax. Drag to paint resist and keep those places cream; double-tap clears the soot and turns the smoke. Drag to paint, double-tap to re-fire.

pieces.title: Apprentice
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's father-daughter lineage: a master vessel at the left and a family of smaller pots to its right, each child inheriting the profile with a slight mutation of form and colour. Tap and one more generation grows. Tap to grow a generation.

pieces.title: Calabash
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's harvest calabash: a squat pot banded in earthy brown and sea-green, breathing very slowly while its bands slide like a tide and fine speckle drifts up its surface. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Terracotta Speckle
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's terracotta range: a burnt-orange field of raw clay, dense with cream and dark speckle. Drag to stir the speckle into swirls; let go and it settles back to stillness. Drag to stir.

pieces.title: Basin Rings
pieces.note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's top-down basin: concentric glaze rings, an ochre rim, a celadon ring and a dark-red centre pool under a fine crackle, turning with glacial slowness, each ring at its own pace while the crackle holds still. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Salt Worn
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's salt-eroded porcelain: a cream vessel whose lower half is pitted matte bone, its upper half holding a smooth teal glaze, a ragged shoreline between them where the tide breathes and slowly recedes, barnacles clinging along the line. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Slow Dissolve
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's Slow Dissolve: a tall dark vessel with a green-blue crackled glaze pouring from the shoulder in long drips toward a pale stone base. Drag to smear new drips downward; double-tap reseeds the pour. Drag to smear, double-tap to re-pour.

pieces.title: Crater and Gloop
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's crater and gloop glazes: a glossy black skin pocked with golden crater rings, silver-grey streaks melting down between them. Tap to replant the constellation; double-tap regrows the silver. Tap to replant, double-tap to regrow.

pieces.title: Belly Crack
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's sodium-silicate crackle: a pale slip-white vessel whose geometric fracture network grows as its belly slowly swells, then holds as the belly relaxes. Tap to re-seed the fractures; double-tap holds the swell. Tap to re-seed, double-tap to hold.

pieces.title: Wobble Mug
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's classic Hound wobble mug: a squat black-clay mug with a deep radial wobble in its wall and a smooth satin inside. Drag to twist the wobble; double-tap reseeds it. Drag to twist, double-tap to re-throw.

pieces.title: Never Clock Off
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's NEVER CLOCK OFF timepiece (with Ruby Waters): a vessel fused with a clock face, a small fish swimming its slow orbit while the hands keep real time. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Gold Seam
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's kintsugi repair philosophy: a dark vessel breaks along glowing seams and reassembles, each cycle leaving its gold lines behind. Tap to break it now; double-tap freezes the break. Tap to break, double-tap to hold the break.

pieces.title: Test Tiles
pieces.note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's thousands of glaze test tiles: a 4x5 museum grid of special-effects glazes, each tile running its own micro-loop. Drag to swirl the tiles you cross; double-tap reseeds the grid. Drag to swirl, double-tap to re-tile.

pieces.title: Puffer Time
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' puffer clock: a spiky tattoo-flash puffer, squiggle over dots, googly eyes tracking you, keeping real time from its brass centre. Drag a spike to wobble it; tap to puff. Drag to wobble, tap to puff.

pieces.title: Kawaii Vessels Grid
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' Kawaii Vessels print: a 4x3 flash sheet of creature-vessels, planters, pots, a cat-lamp and an octopus-pot, blinking and swaying in slow cascade, each cell alive on its own phase. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Kokeshi Stack
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' kokeshi dolls: a moon-face doll on a cone body of stacked pattern bands, stripes, lotus, chrysanthemum and waves, a tiny Mt Fuji at its base breathing small clouds, swaying like a weeble. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Dala Engine
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' Dala horse: a blocky painted toy horse, polka-dot fields and an S-curve flourish, its raffia tail a hundred swaying strands. Drag through the tail to part it; tap the saddle medallion to ripple its spots. Drag the tail, tap the medallion.

pieces.title: Wave Ground
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' onna-musha painting: a warrior in vermilion and mint rides a still folk horse while the banded cobalt wave ground scrolls beneath, near rows faster than far. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Squiggle and Dot
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' two-tone pattern split: cadmium yellow and black squiggles above a hard wavy seam, white and orange dots below, the seam breathing and the dots pulsing in traveling waves. Drag to push the seam; it springs back. Drag to push the seam.

pieces.title: Okame Mask Field
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' okame masks: eleven round moon faces with black bobs and high blush drifting at three depths over faint giant chrysanthemums, bobbing on staggered phases, one slow blink every eight seconds. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Flash Drop
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' flash sheets: nine creature motifs on cream, inked live one cell every four seconds: outline, flat colour flood, detail pass, holding as a finished sheet before washing back to bare outlines. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Never Clock Off Wall
pieces.note: After Ruby Waters' NEVER CLOCK OFF show: five creature-clocks on a gallery wall, puffer, octopus, tengu, boar and kokeshi-face, all telling real time with black hands, brass name plates below. Tap a clock and it jumps down and wakes. Tap a clock.

pieces.title: Honeyeater Perch
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's native-bird flash: a New Holland Honeyeater in white linework on deep navy, bottlebrush at the branch tip, a small silvereye study below, one petal falling each loop. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Babushka Stack
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's babushka dolls: a grumpy cat in a polka-dot scarf over a peony torso and striped pot base. Tap the head to cycle the animal: chihuahua, croc, mermaid, each with its own scarf. Tap the head.

pieces.title: Panther Tatt-Tour
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's vintage panther: a cream ceramic panther covered in underglaze-cobalt tattoo motifs, MUM heart, barbed wire, mermaid, dragon, dice and swallows, with her white dog and cat companions below. Drag to tour the body; tap a motif to watch it inked in three passes. Drag to tour; tap a motif.

pieces.title: Swan Quartet
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's swan vase: one swan motif repeated four times around a porcelain vase in cobalt underglaze, reeds between, one swan bowing every nine seconds. Drag to turn the vessel; it settles at the nearest quarter-turn. Drag to rotate.

pieces.title: Tile Trial Grid
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's sgraffito tile trials: twenty handmade crackle-glazed tiles on dark timber, each carved through to the clay with a flower, bird, skull or banksia pod, one corner tile mended with gold. Tap a tile to re-carve it; drag to shift the tabletop. Tap a tile.

pieces.title: Flash Sheet Twelve
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's twelve-print series: a flash sheet of twelve motifs, cowboy, cranes, Pharaoh's horses, parrot, panther, snake, croc, wagtail, banksia and mermaid, with hand-lettered labels. Drag cells to mix and match; tap one for its signature move. Drag to rearrange; tap a cell.

pieces.title: Wagtail Loop
pieces.note: After Ali Fisher's willy wagtail: a black-and-white wagtail in white linework on deep navy, tail pumping in its real herky-jerky bursts, three, pause, two, over banksia pods and eucalyptus. Watch-only.

pieces.title: Scrying Cauldron
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's cauldron mugs: a squat dark cauldron with a jagged flame rim and two glowing vents, a tea-light beside it, the black liquid inside holding faint drifting visions. Drag to stir the scrying pool; tap the rim for a gold glint. Drag to stir; tap the rim.

pieces.title: Tiny Hut Row
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's incense cottages: five tiny cream huts on chicken feet under a night sky, incense smoke curling from every chimney, one hut now and then scratching and settling. Tap a hut to flare its window and pour the smoke. Tap a hut.

pieces.title: Arcane Inventory
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's Arcanum releases: an apothecary shelf of her cauldrons, potion bottles, pumpkin jars, gem boxes and towers, each with its numbered release plate, rarity and usage line, and three field applications below. Tap a vessel to issue the next release. Tap a vessel.

pieces.title: Tower of Chance
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's wizard towers: a stacked clay tower with glowing slits, backflow smoke at its chimney and mist at its seams, three bone dice at its foot. Drag a die into the roof mouth and it tumbles out the door; tap the chimney for a backflow pulse. Drag a die; tap the chimney.

pieces.title: Embellish & Cast
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's mould ritual: a plain plaster mould, the same form embellished with band, crimped rim, feet and a sprig, and three slip-cast copies in red, grey and black. Tap the middle to draw on a new variant; tap the casts for a new colorway. Tap a stage.

pieces.title: Marble & Transfer
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's marbled mugs: brown-and-cream swirled clay with a crisp black silkscreen transfer, wattle, bee, banksia or butterfly, stamped over it. Drag to re-swirl the clay under the print; tap to stamp the next motif. Drag to stir the clay; tap to stamp.

pieces.title: Potion Pair
pieces.note: After Xanthe Caesia's potion bottles: a raku black bottle and a cream cobalt-swirled bottle, linked by a gold thread between their corks, potion light glowing at each seam. Drag one and its pair follows; tap a cork for a pulse. Drag a bottle; tap a cork.

pieces.title: Gum Blossom Engine
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's Eucalyptus Blossoms screen: six gum blossoms on the dark, caps lifting, gold stamens unfurling in bursts, narrow leaves on woody stems. Tap a blossom to scatter its stamens and watch it regrow. Tap a blossom.

pieces.title: Ditzy Field
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's ditzy prints: a full field of teeny vermilion gum blossoms on cream paper, a slow swell wave crossing diagonally. Drag to press the motifs up to full size under your finger. Drag to press.

pieces.title: Three-Part Registration
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's three-part screens: one botanical composition printed in vermilion, teal and mustard layers, overlaps mixing where the inks cross. Drag a layer out of registration; double-tap to snap it back. Drag a layer; double-tap to register.

pieces.title: Monoline Study
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's monoline drawings: one black line, one weight, drawing a gum blossom, a wattle spray and a banksia cone in turn on white paper, each in a single unbroken-weight hand. Tap to skip to the next specimen. Tap to skip.

pieces.title: Three Architectures
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's botanical screens: three flower architectures side by side, a banksia cone of spikelets, a bottlebrush of swaying filaments, wattle poms on branching stems. Tap a panel to regrow it in a new variant. Tap a panel.

pieces.title: Crackle Screen
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's Marble Crackle screen: a black crackle network printed flat on white, a window onto an endless field, a few cells tinted celadon. Drag to pan the field; tap for a new constellation. Drag to pan; tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Cockatoo Press
pieces.note: After Coral Cockatoo's brand bird: a sulphur-crested cockatoo in flat print colours on eucalyptus teal, crest rising and falling, perched on a diagonal branch. Tap for three quick head-bobs. Tap for a head-bob.

pieces.title: Scallop Field
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's scallop tiles: a full field of scalloped cells, gingko fans and tiny daisies alternating, a slow wave turning the cells over diagonally. Tap a cell to flip its orientation. Tap a cell.

pieces.title: Hide and Seek
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's hide-and-seek wallpaper: a dense daisy and gingko field in greens and teal, seven butterflies hidden in it by colour, worms, snails and spiders planted to mislead. Tap a butterfly when you spot one; double-tap for a fresh field. Tap to seek; double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Celestial Gingko
