pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's Celestial Gingko texture: scalloped rows of gold-line gingko fans on a near-black teal ground, tiny cream flowers at their bases, a shimmer travelling row by row. Tap a fan to shed its gold spores. Tap a fan.

pieces.title: Thirty Days, One Palette
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's 30-day fixed-palette collab: thirty tiles in a 6 by 5 grid, a fox, holly, a wreath and twenty-seven more prompts from her Natural Christmas list, every tile drawn in the same five colours. Tap a tile to see its prompt up close. Tap a tile.

pieces.title: Buffalo Plaid Bee
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's buffalo plaid bee entry: a bold red and black plaid with one cartoon bee resting on every few checks, wings shivering in turn. Drag across the plaid to lift the bees near your finger. Drag to disturb the bees.

pieces.title: Swirling Vines
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's Swirling Vines: six jungle vines trailing down a cream ground, curling and unfurling at their tips, daisies and leaves at their nodes. Drag through them to bend them like wind. Drag to bend the vines.

pieces.title: Cheater Quilt
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's cheater quilt: a 5 by 5 grid of squares pretending to be sewn, plaid, daisy-scallop, starburst and berry stripes, one square always re-sewing itself stroke by stroke. Tap a square to swap its pattern. Tap a square.

pieces.title: Moonbeams
pieces.note: After Debbie Sharman's moonlight scallops: a dark field of scallop tiles, a cream moon and gold beams in each, alternating by default because she could not choose. Tap a tile to flip it; double-tap to try another arrangement. Tap a tile; double-tap to rearrange.

pieces.title: Ways of Protection
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Ways of Protection at Old Leh: nine kite forms hung in dark air, triangular windows glowing rose to peach as each kite drifts along her fear-to-hope axis. Drag through them to gust the field. Drag to gust the kites.

pieces.title: Fear Hope Field
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's two-pole palette: a stepped dye-lot field running diagonally from warning red to wellbeing teal, drifting on slow currents. Touch to resolve the colour where you press; double-tap for a new current. Touch the field; double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Singhay Chosgyal
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Singhay Chosgyal: a white-line wrathful deity in eight-fold symmetry on black, perfectly still, while a red, yellow and green field churns inside its disc. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Cartographies of Cloth
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Cartographies of Cloth: felted contour lines in rust and terracotta with one dark river ribbon running the steepest path through them. Drag to raise the land and the river finds a new way down. Drag to reshape the terrain.

pieces.title: At Nature's Mercy
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's At Nature's Mercy: a sheer grey curtain in a dark room, one small black-and-white mountain low on the fabric, breathing almost imperceptibly on a forty-second cycle. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Spring Convenor
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Spring Convenor: a bamboo mirror on black fabric, covered in red hand-written strips, one carrying her line about Nature as God. Pass a finger near the strips and they lean toward you. Move near the strips to lean them.

pieces.title: Raudra Roop
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Raudra Roop: a wrathful glazed mask, crown of skulls and spiral brows, perfectly still while its turquoise glaze flows and pools in the crevices on a sixty-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Red Triangle
pieces.note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's degree show: a tall red-lit triangle in a black room, fire churning inside it, dark masks at its base with red-lit eyes, the edge light breathing on a thirty-second cycle. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Cutter Stack
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's bird cutter stacks: one hand-wobbled bird profile as seven concentric outlines at a one-and-a-half size progression, breathing like a cut being pressed and released on a twenty-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Double Inset
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's Double Ellipse Inset Hoopla: three nested ellipses on near-black, the middle ring scalloped in gold, eight small inset studies around the margin. Drag sideways to slide the middle ring, it eases home on release. Drag to slide the inset.

pieces.title: Puffy
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's puffy fridge frames: a small blob form inflating and deflating on a sixteen-second loop, shaded in stepped flat bands with no gradient anywhere. Drag across it to dent it, it springs back. Drag to dent.

pieces.title: Click-In Grammar
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's Click n Clay Multi Jig: six rainbow-arch cells, each holding one cream insert from a set of four - star, heart, flower, dot. Tap a cell to click a new insert in, double-tap to re-deal the board. Tap a cell, double-tap to re-deal.

pieces.title: Make Shake
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's Make Shake game: three dice roll a profile, a stack count and a palette, and the study below is built from exactly that roll. Double-tap to shake again and the picture re-rolls with the dice. Double-tap to shake.

pieces.title: Flat Net
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's bow cutter: a flat paper net of a bow, loops, knot and tails with dashed terracotta score lines, folding itself up into a dusty-rose bow and unfolding again on a twenty-four-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Trinket Drape
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's trinket dishes: a twelve-petal dish seen from directly above on near-black, shaded in four flat teal bands, turning slowly while a ripple travels petal to petal on a twenty-eight-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Spaghetti Monster
pieces.note: After MyClayCo's failed print: a cream toolpath draws a scalloped frame neatly for eight seconds, then the print fails and it blooms into a hot-coral tangle before the bed clears. Drag to feed noise into the line. Drag to make spaghetti.

pieces.title: Night Visitors
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's hidden-motif damask: an antique ogee lattice in bone on near-black, with sixteen ghosts, bats and owls hidden in the same ink, only their ember eyes blinking in slow sequence. Drag to pan and zoom and hunt for them. Drag to hunt.

pieces.title: Harlequin Haunt
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's harlequin diamonds: fifty-four diamonds, each holding exactly one ghost, cat, star, swirl or bat, with a slow wave pulse rippling across the grid. Drag to push the wave. Drag to disturb the haunt.

pieces.title: Cheater Quilt
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's cheater quilt: twenty squares of celestial, tweed, pinstripe, damask and star patterns with printed sew-lines between them, each square looping on its own. Double-tap a square to advance its pattern. Double-tap to resew a square.

pieces.title: Enid Engine
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's Enid floral: a twisty ogee damask on near-black that grows inward from the edges, ember blooms opening at the branch tips, then recedes and begins again on a twenty-eight-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Murder in the Garden
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's Murder in the Garden: a poisonous-flower lattice on near-black, three of its thirty blooms blood red, with one tiny key and one small bird hidden among them and spores drifting over all of it on a twenty-four-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Helmet Cats
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's MCM kitties: a parade of flat geometric cats marching across paper, circle heads and triangle ears, some in stroked-arc space helmets, tails swaying on a seamless loop. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Tweed Field
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's chunky tweed: thousands of short thread strokes woven in rows in three yarn colours, a slow sheen band travelling the weave while a bone moth and crescent moon drift half-buried in it. Watch only. Watch.

pieces.title: Colorway Machine
pieces.note: After Emi Bee's coordinate-family machine: one twisty floral sprig rendered twelve times in a grid, each cell a different curated colourway over its own ground, every cell breathing on its own phase. Drag sideways to scrub new colourways through the grid. Drag to re-colour.

pieces.title: Harlequin Overflow
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's Merry Maximalist harlequin: a zero-margin diamond patchwork in hot pink, kelly and royal blue, every diamond holding one small Christmas vignette, some bleeding past their borders, the whole repeat slowly drifting. Drag to pan, double-tap to reshuffle the packing. Drag to pan, double-tap to reshuffle.

pieces.title: Neon Midnight Garden
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's Neon midnight garden: dense flat neon florals, dahlias, sunflowers and moths in hot pink and violet on near-black, opening and closing in travelling waves. Drag through them and the blooms lean away and spring back. Drag to disturb the garden.

pieces.title: Owl and Oak Damask
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's midnight owl and oak folk damask: a mirrored ogee lattice on navy whose motifs are heraldic owls with spread wings, oak sprays, acorns and crescent moons, breathing slowly while the owl eyes blink in sequence. Drag to pan the damask. Drag to pan.

pieces.title: Swirl / Potager
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's prompt-word challenge: a word-to-pattern machine where two challenge words pick a motif family and a container grammar, this one opening on Swirl / Potager. Tap for the next word pair, double-tap to re-lay the same words. Tap for new words, double-tap to re-lay.

pieces.title: Prairie Plaid Bloom
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's prairie wildflower plaid: a hand-uneven woven plaid in wheat, denim and clay with flat wildflowers overflowing its lines, heads nodding in a slow wind wave. Tap to advance the plaid colours. Tap to re-colour the plaid.

pieces.title: Delft Tiles
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's Delft tiles: a cobalt-on-white tile grid, every tile holding one small hand-drawn vignette, a moth, a berry sprig, a blue tit, a tulip, with corner flourishes, while a sheen band travels the grid. Tap a tile to advance its vignette. Tap a tile to change it.

pieces.title: Six Colorways
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's colourway sheets: one hero motif set of sunflower, moth and oak spray rendered six times as a contact sheet, each cell in a different flat palette, breathing gently. Tap a cell to promote its colourway full-bleed, double-tap to come back to a fresh set. Tap a cell, double-tap to return.

pieces.title: Dark Academia, Three Ways
pieces.note: After Suchita Prakash's Dark Academia curation: one fixed five-ink palette, plum, ink, oxblood, parchment and moss, run through three grammars at once, ogee damask, berry lattice and Delft-style tile, each panel drifting at its own rate. Double-tap for a new collection in the same palette. Double-tap for a new collection.

pieces.title: Goldline Poppies
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's Dramatic Deco Poppies: oversized deep-teal poppy heads at wallpaper scale, every petal edge traced in a flat gold contour on near-black, breathing on a slow bloom pulse. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip to the golden colourway. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip.

pieces.title: Stingray Trellis
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's Stingray Wallpaper: white-etched stingrays whose wingspans interlock into an ogee trellis on black, ring-dot starfield in the gaps, wings breathing slowly. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed the starfield. Drag to pan, double-tap for new stars.

pieces.title: Snowy Owl Stare
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's Snowy Owls: giant snowy-owl faces in half-drop repeat on gold-ochre, black brow wedges and orange eyes staring straight out, blinking one at a time on a slow stagger. Drag to pan, double-tap to change who blinks first. Drag to pan.

pieces.title: Dandelion Medallions
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's Dandelions: a purple vine scrollwork lattice on salmon framing giant coral dandelion medallions, crisp starbursts with dot fills, rotating slowly as the vines sway. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed the medallions. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Sandpiper Pair
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's sandpipers: cream sandpipers in conversing pairs on warm caramel, stippled umber feather texture, long legs and probing beaks, one head dipping now and then in each pair. Drag to pan, double-tap to reshuffle the pairs. Drag to pan, double-tap to reshuffle.

pieces.title: Lobster Stripefield
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's lobsters and stripes: bold navy and cream horizontal bands sliding slowly like a tide, hand-drawn coral lobsters stamped along the stripe boundaries and riding them. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip to the sunset stripes. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip.

pieces.title: Poe Traits
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's Poe-traits: portrait medallions of Poe, dark hair, moustache and high collar in parchment and ink, in a diamond grid on plum-ink, with ravens, keyholes, quills and skull-moths between, the whole field breathing like candlelight. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed the motifs. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Salt Air
pieces.note: After Julianne Haness's Salt Air: a faded coastal repeat of wave-scallop rows in sea-glass, sand, coral and washed navy, gulls and blossom sprays scattered through it, the rows drifting at three gentle speeds. Drag to pan, double-tap to change the song. Drag to pan, double-tap to change the song.

pieces.title: Thistle Crest
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's Dark Academia damask: a mirrored thistle crest in antique-gold linework on near-black, repeated half-drop with spread-wing ravens woven between the columns, the gold breathing slowly. Drag sideways to shear the lattice, double-tap for the next heraldic crest. Drag to shear, double-tap for a new crest.

pieces.title: Fiddlehead Biome
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's Forest Biome: a fern toss on near-black, forty fiddleheads uncurling and re-curling on staggered phases, arching fronds and cream butterflies in the gaps. Drag through it for a breeze, the fronds bend and the butterflies scatter and resettle. Drag for a breeze.

pieces.title: Hummingbird Trailing
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's Timeless Nursery: Morris-style trailing vines on cream with fine-line hummingbirds hovering at the nodes, wings fluttering on their hover bob, the whole field drifting slowly downward. Tap a bird and it darts to a new node, drag to pan the trailing. Tap a bird, drag to pan.

pieces.title: Eye-Spiral Tree
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's vyshyvanka Tree of Life: a mirror-symmetric tree on cream with three tiers of eye-spiral flowers, teal irises ringed in ochre and coral, flanking birds and diamond cross-stitch borders, the eyes rotating slowly. Drag across it to sway the branches, double-tap for a new iris palette. Drag to sway, double-tap for new irises.

pieces.title: Sunflower Suite
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's collection architecture: six panels from one motif library, hero sunflower toss, owl print on sage, petal blender on chocolate, gingham check, line-art sketch and sepia bird flight, each looping gently. Tap a panel to expand it, drag sideways to scrub the suite. Tap to expand, drag to scrub.

pieces.title: Moth Mosaic
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's moth suite: a great dusky moth on deep plum whose spread wings are an 8x8 mosaic, every tile a tiny petal, leaf, dot or spiral in stepped blue-to-lavender, the wings beating slowly. Drag near a wing to ripple the tiles, double-tap to reseed the mosaic. Drag to ripple, double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Dark Eggs
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's Dark Eggs: twelve near-black eggs on near-black, each a gold field of tiny thistles, crescents, eye-spirals and cross-stitch diamonds inside a thin gold ring, sprigs in the gutters, the gold shimmering. Tap an egg to open its locket, drag to scramble them home. Tap to open, drag to scramble.

pieces.title: Hydrangea Bloom
pieces.note: After Olena Kovalova's hydrangea tile: one giant hydrangea head on deep green, twenty-five four-lobed florets in bold dark-brown contour, stepped blue-to-lavender petals and cream starburst centres, pulsing gently. Drag across it to ripple the florets, double-tap to move the light. Drag to ripple, double-tap to move the light.

pieces.title: Night Sky Toss
pieces.note: After Jen K's Undersea Night Sky: a dense celestial toss on deep navy, 240 flat icons in three bands, gold moons and whales, moths and all-seeing eyes, crystals and tiny houses, the gold stars twinkling as everything drifts. Drag to stir the field, the icons swirl and settle home. Drag to stir.

pieces.title: Marine Building Fan
pieces.note: After Jen K's Marine Building fan: an art-deco sunburst on near-black, 36 gold ray bundles spreading 140 degrees with cream moons, eyes and crystals shrinking toward the arc and one oxblood band, a shimmer sweeping the rays as they breathe. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Romantsy Toile
pieces.note: After Jen K's Romantasy Toile: purple line-art vignettes on cream, dragons, castles, books, swords and crowns in half-drop, no filled shapes, a faint sparkle over them, the whole field inking itself in, holding, and fading to redraw. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Boho Jungle
pieces.note: After Jen K's Boho Jungle: five flat hero animals on light beige, a spotted leopard, striped tigers and a zebra packed in spiky leaves and berry dots with no space left over, leaves swaying as the animals breathe. Drag near an animal and it turns toward you, then settles. Drag to turn.

pieces.title: Witchy Woman
pieces.note: After Jen K's Witchy Woman: a dense jewel-tone floral toss on near-black plum, poppies, daisies and chrysanthemums with gold moons, evil-eye dots and crystal shards in every gap, blooms pulsing as the gold shimmers. Drag to carry a moonlight through it. Drag to carry the moonlight.

pieces.title: First Collection, Again
pieces.note: After Jen K's archive mining: a maximalist toss rebuilt from her own ten-motif bank, crescents, eyes, moths, ravens, tulips and more, each generation drawing five to seven of them in a single palette duo on near-black. Double-tap for the next collection from the archive. Double-tap for a new generation.

pieces.title: Palm Springs Fever
pieces.note: After Jen K's Palm Springs fever dream: a flat midcentury desert, banded sunset sky, low sun, dunes and one palm silhouette, with two translucent strata sliding over it, teal cacti and stars below, big purple paisleys and sunbursts above. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Peaceful Birch
pieces.note: After Jen K's Peaceful Birch: eleven pale birch trunks on a moody teal-black ground, black bark marks, sage leaves low in the understory and gold leaf-dots falling slowly through a faint drifting mist. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Toile, But Make It Yoga
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's toile subversion: classic Toile de Jouy vignettes on warm paper, but the scenes are yoga poses, warrior, tree, downward dog, dancer, lotus, cobra, child and crescent, inked in loud coral, teal, mustard and plum, breathing slowly like held poses. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Cloud Dancer Tiles
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's Delft whimsy: 64 hand-wobbled tiles in strict Delft blue on white, cats, cupcakes, waves, palms, tomatoes, sailboats, books and hearts where the windmills used to be, and one Cloud Dancer tile hiding a single tiny cloud. A glaze shimmer sweeps as tiles redraw themselves. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Sun Moon Cloud
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's folklore field: folk suns with closed-eye faces, cream crescents, scalloped clouds and pine silhouettes on khaki green, navy stars twinkling, the clouds drifting on slow crossings. Drag to stir the sky, the motifs swirl and settle home. Drag to stir.

pieces.title: Vulnerable
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's conservation cards: a yelkouan shearwater gliding over a wash sea with its pale reflection rippling below, ink underdrawing showing, and beneath it her data strip, five status bands with Vulnerable lit in orange and one fact line. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Too Small to Matter
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's tiny marine stories: a pale sea spirit kneeling by a glowing purple flabellina on a dark seabed, light rays shifting, plankton rising, and her four-line dialogue as caption cards below. Tap to turn the conversation. Tap to advance the story.

pieces.title: F is for Fox
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's ABC book: one picture-book card, a huge coral letter with the animal bursting across it and her funny-fact line beneath, opening on F is for fox, fascinating, furry, and fast. Double-tap to turn the page through the alphabet menagerie. Double-tap for the next card.

pieces.title: What Does This Bean Become?
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's bean game: one ink bean on watercolor paper that refuses to stay a bean, an acorn dreaming of Napoleon, a rabbit swimming in borscht, an egg becoming a chick, each tap morphing it one stage further. Tap to transform it, double-tap for a fresh bean. Tap to morph.

pieces.title: The Secret Life of the Still Life
pieces.note: After Maryna Lagereva's still life doctrine: pears and a squash on a wooden table, watercolor quiet but quietly alive, the pears leaning together like conspirators, the stem curling, a beetle crossing once a minute, under her line: if your pictures do not tell a story, they are worthless. Drag near a pear and it leans to listen. Drag to lean a pear.

pieces.title: Wimmelwald
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's Wimmelwald: a snowy forest village at dusk, candle gold in the windows, a frozen lake below, and ten tiny stories hiding in it, skating bears, a badger family with a tree, gnomes at the bakery, a letter fox, a choir of mice. Tap a scene to lean in close, double-tap to step back. Tap a hidden scene.

pieces.title: Triple Prompt
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's Wonderful Winter Week: a prompt engine in one character, one garment, one animal, one thing per deal, a jaguar in a knitted accessory holding a festive headband and seven stranger meetings after it. Double-tap to deal the next triple, drag to sway the model. Double-tap to deal again.

pieces.title: September Briefs
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's art challenge calendars: a month of briefs as twelve tiny finished pictures, cozy cats, an autumn wreath, mushrooms, a golden sun, a fox, a winter forest, one accent colour per cell, the calendar quietly re-inking itself cell by cell. Double-tap for a fresh month. Watch it fill, double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Nine Cats
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's cat contact sheet: eight cats in costume around her wordmark, a gardener in overalls, a scholar with telescope, a frog hat on a watermelon, a knitted cactus hugged close, all breathing softly in their cells. Tap a cat to recostume it. Tap a cat.

pieces.title: Mushroom Hat Parade
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's costume parade: six animals marching across the dark in their one big costume piece, a kitten under a mushroom cap, an elephant in a star tutu, a frog hat, a poncho, a cello carried like a banner, neon flat on near-black. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Five Hundred Pieces
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's puzzle pipeline: a sundae garden with a cat asleep on a waffle, cut into seventy jigsaw pieces that start scattered and click home in a ripple from the centre. Drag to burst it apart, double-tap to scatter it again. Drag to scatter, double-tap to re-scatter.

pieces.title: The Fox Lady
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's Fellow Fox: one fox, six professions, librarian among the book spines, baker, astronomer, gardener, cellist, ice-skater, each scene assembling around her as she walks in. Double-tap to send her off to the next job. Double-tap to change scene.

pieces.title: Snow Cello
pieces.note: After Anna Galitskaya's winter leopard: a leopard in a snowy clearing at night, bowing a cello while the snow falls and small gold notes lift off the strings and fade. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Hair River
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's hair river: her white-haired muse in profile on textured gold, her hair leaving her head as a broad white river carrying three teal birds, golden leaves and white petals across the frame, a flat sunburst behind her. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Shrine
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's body-as-landscape: her muse in profile on deep navy, her shawl a purple mountain night holding a tiny manger, palms and a winding path under an eight-point star that breathes light at her sternum. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Costume Triple
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's costume resolution: her muse dressed by the prompt dice, the animal worn as a print, the thing worn as a prop, opening on the jaguar turtleneck and the giant fuchsia bow. Double-tap to deal her a new costume, drag to tilt the portrait. Double-tap to deal again.

pieces.title: Morning Book
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's morning book: her muse in a halo of white hair shaped like a heart, holding a small dark-red book as cosmos flowers grow out of its pages, one quiet line fading as it opens: hope is a quiet morning. Tap the book and the flowers open another stage. Tap the book.

pieces.title: Pink Water
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's Monet homage: her muse standing in pink water, flat pink and purple lily pads on dark teal, hot-pink dress, teal umbrella high, hair and scarf streaming behind her under a pink sky. A single white petal crosses now and then. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Bear Hug
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's 2020 seed: her muse hugging a huge cream polar bear on blush, both in red, her paper crown tilted, a brown tree behind them, as they rock gently together in the falling snow and the bear's ear twitches once a turn. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Edition Engine
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's challenge engine: a living announcement poster in her style, the muse in the header, the prompt rows, the rules and the host dots below, redesigning itself by season from September's cozy prompts to December's costume triples to July's masters. Double-tap to turn the season, drag to scroll the rows. Double-tap for the next season.

pieces.title: Sleeve
pieces.note: After Nina Clausonet's packaging: a tall navy sleeve tossed with coral tulips, cream stars, wheat and little women, its title band in flat geometric letters, a few motifs escaped into the cream margin and drifting up like seeds. Drag to turn the sleeve, double-tap for a new scatter. Drag to rotate, double-tap to re-scatter.

pieces.title: Cat Window
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's Golden Sun: an arched window on deep olive, a huge stippled orange sun in the arch, and on the checkered sill an orange striped cat flicking its tail beside a green planter and a red polka-dot mug breathing steam. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Coffee Cats
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's black coffee cats: a giant two-tone cup on cream, four black cats with yellow eyes emerging from the coffee while purple steam curls and orbs drift. Tap the cup and they dip with a splash, ripple the coffee and bob back up. Tap the cup.

pieces.title: Tuesday Funtivity
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's Tuesday Funtivity: her orange cat with sparkle eyes and a green dotted scarf, sitting in a gold-latticed leaf bag beside a big pumpkin on hot pink, autumn leaves falling through starbursts. Drag and a gust streams through the leaves. Drag to gust.

pieces.title: Eat Your Colors
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's Eat Your Colors: six giant vegetables on flat orange, each split into two clashing tones, eggplant, carrot, garlic, pepper, zucchini and celery, breathing slowly while one at a time does a small wiggle under twinkling sparkles. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Sax Bouquet
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's metamorphosis: a girl in a red polka-dot dress playing saxophone on flat pink, her waist melting into stems while the bell bursts into a bouquet of cat heads, two-tone flowers and leaves that slowly blooms and relaxes as note-petals drift up. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Pattern Walker
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's pattern-stacked walker: a girl mid-stride on peachy cream in an orange polka-dot top and olive pants with pink stripes, a scalloped tote with a cat face bouncing at her shoulder, a pink mushroom book in her hands, autumn leaves falling around her. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Neon Shoe
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's Vans maximalism: a giant white sneaker on a checkerboard floor under a hot pink sky, neon leaves, five watching eyes on stems, a watermelon slice, a huge pencil, and a black cat in headphones on the toe, phone flickering. Drag and the diorama pans. Drag to pan.

pieces.title: Noodle Lift
pieces.note: After Yeti Iglesias's first ramen: a red bowl of orange broth on hot pink, egg, narutomaki spirals and nori, a neon-yellow hand lifting ten noodle strands on dark chopsticks that sway and steam. Tap the bowl and the chopsticks lift higher. Tap the bowl.

pieces.title: Scooter Girl
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's first scooter girl: a woman pushing off on a kick-scooter over mustard, daisy tee, purple patterned pants, a net bag spilling flowers, her spotted dachshund trotting at the front wheel. Drag and the whole scene rolls. Drag to roll.

pieces.title: Daydreamers
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Daydreamers: four portraits in a grid, beach, safari, spa and ski dreaming inside their sunglasses, waves lapping and snow falling in miniature. Tap a portrait and its lenses re-dream to the next scene. Tap a portrait.

pieces.title: Funk My Life
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's funk poster: a woman with a huge afro and flower earrings, chin up inside a pink gig-poster frame on dark plum, FUNK MY LIFE arching over her in hand-lettered caps that groove slowly while her earrings swing and the stars twinkle. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Mahjong Babies
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Mahjong for Babies: twelve chunky tiles on cream, smiling suns, bamboo, blooms, cloud winds and toucan jokers, every one with the same two-dot smile under a banner that says it's time to play. Tap a tile and it bounces, blinks and sparkles. Tap a tile.

pieces.title: DOGUE
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's DOGUE: a brown poodle cover girl in a red beret, sunglasses and a heart-print jacket on hot pink, masthead across the top and cover lines down the side. Tap and the lines re-set from her humour pool, best girl, wag more, treat yourself. Tap for new cover lines.

pieces.title: Fruit Fashion
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's fruit fashion: a woman in a watermelon bucket hat holding a pear stamped FRESH, then an afro and lemon-print dress, then banana earrings and a toucan balanced on a fruit stack. Tap and the next look slides in. Tap for the next character.

pieces.title: Science of Bliss
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Science of Bliss: a woman meditating on soft lavender under pink hand-lettering while email badges, to-do scraps and a BUY ME button orbit her head, a dopamine molecule of smiley faces floating by. Drag through the clutter and it dissolves into sparkles. Drag to clear the noise.

pieces.title: Mood Boosters
pieces.note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Mood Boosters for May: four little calendar joys, a sunglassed sun over brighter days are coming, pockets full of flowers, a beach day with a dripping ice cream, and a polka-dot umbrella twirling through April showers. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Long Lunch
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's long lunch: a red and pink checkered cloth laid with a bottle of VINO, two glasses of red wine, salad, lemons, papaya, a vase of flowers and one lit candle against the leaves. Double-tap and the table is laid again, another way. Double-tap to re-lay the table.

pieces.title: Golden Sun
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's golden sun: one huge flat sun turning slowly over a balcony, a woman in pink watering her terracotta pots, leaves trailing in from the corner. Drag and the air stirs through the leaves. Drag to stir the air.

pieces.title: Self-Care Waltz
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's self-care waltz: a woman dancing barefoot at night in pink headphones, wine glass raised, music notes rising, two cats asleep on the rug in the lamplight. Watch only. Watch only.

pieces.title: Leaf Picnic
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's leaf picnic: four hands of three skin tones share a lattice pie on a pink checked blanket, coffee pouring into a blue mug while fall leaves tumble past. Double-tap and the pie becomes cake, a bread basket, a fruit bowl. Double-tap for another dish.

pieces.title: Vintage Hobby Room
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's vintage hobby room: a woman reading on a magenta rug, a cream cat batting an orange yarn ball, a mint record player spinning in the corner, steam rising off a blue mug. Drag and the vinyl spins faster; double-tap re-lays the room. Drag to spin, double-tap to re-lay.

pieces.title: Golden City
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's golden city: a postcard square at noon, statue column, red roofs and green domes under one big sun, six tiny strollers on the plaza, one with a teddy bear, a camera flashing now and then, birds crossing. Drag and the square shifts in depth. Drag to look around.

pieces.title: First Light
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's first light: a brass menorah on deep indigo, its nine candles lighting one by one, each flame blooming a small warm halo, then all swaying together before the ceremony begins again. Double-tap to replay the lighting. Double-tap to replay.

pieces.title: Magical Holidays Rink
pieces.note: After Yael Hofri's magical holidays rink: four skaters gliding hand-in-hand around a moonlit rink, trails fading behind their blades, a lit tree, toy stalls and string lights twinkling over the snow. Drag and a breeze moves their scarves. Drag for a breeze.

pieces.title: Hair That Becomes a World
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's hair that becomes a world: her white hair rises and turns into a snowy miniature landscape of houses, pines and deer under a smiling crescent moon, while she reads below in a red zigzag sweater. Snow falls only inside the hair. Double-tap for a new landscape. Double-tap to re-lay the hills.

pieces.title: Three Things in a Pocket
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's three things in a pocket: a woman walks her reindeer across a star-sprinkled ground, shopping bags in hand, a candy-cane stripe on her coat hem. Drag sideways to change her outfit, up or down to change the animal, tap for a whole new trio. Drag to swap, tap to re-deal.

pieces.title: Cardigan Season
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's cardigan season: a white-haired woman in an olive knit sips from a yellow mug at a dark table, a leaf-sketched book and a lattice pie beside her, autumn leaves drifting down one at a time. Watch her sip. Double-tap to re-lay the table.

pieces.title: Dive Repeat
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's dive repeat: a seamless teal pattern of women swimming, every figure different, coral and seaweed between them, folded over a beach towel below. Drag to scroll the pattern forever; double-tap changes the product. Drag to scroll, double-tap to switch.

pieces.title: Picnic From Above
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's picnic from above: a checkered blanket laid with melon, baguette, wine and a straw hat, a dog asleep in the corner, and three friends present only as arms reaching in. Drag to slide the picnic; double-tap lays it again. Drag to slide, double-tap to re-lay.

pieces.title: Five Women, One Pink Ground
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's five women: five busts in a half-ring on a flowered pink ground, every woman in her own pattern, swaying on her own rhythm while a beaded necklace swings. Tap to bring the next woman forward. Tap to rotate the ring.

pieces.title: The Fox Wears the Lights
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's fox in the lights: a woman in a knitted beanie cradles a white fox whose tail is wrapped in festive lights that chase along it, snow drifting, her breath fogging in the cold. Double-tap to re-order the lights. Double-tap to re-order.

pieces.title: Abstract Fruits
pieces.note: After Angelina Bambina's abstract fruits: four seamless fruit patterns in a grid - leaves on mustard, pomegranates in teal and pink, pomegranates on soft pink, speckled dots on gray - each tile breathing gently while its colours rotate through the harvest schemes. Tap to re-seed the patterns. Tap to re-seed.

pieces.title: Night Water
pieces.note: Blue-teal motes drift and breathe in dark water; a few wear faint rings. Click for a new tide.

pieces.title: Contour Drift
pieces.note: Sixty horizontal lines displaced by drifting noise; topographic calm in one ink. Click for a new drift.

pieces.title: Chord Orbits
pieces.note: Three rings of points joined every k-th pair by hairlines; one weaves a web, another a slow star. Click for new orbits.

pieces.title: Desordres
pieces.note: A grid of squares, each disobeying a little; a few burn vermilion. Click for another desordres.

pieces.title: Never Isles
pieces.note: A procedural antique nautical chart: radial-noise archipelago engraved as a maritime plate, with rhumb lines, twin compass roses, hachured relief, and recombined place-names. Click for a new chart.

pieces.title: Silent Score
pieces.note: A polar waveform ring performing a song with no audio.

pieces.title: Budget Ink
pieces.note: A still life shaded on a strict ink budget.

pieces.title: Spiral Zap
pieces.note: One quiet triadic palette spiralled ten times, calm on the left and feral on the right. The tipping point is visible.

pieces.title: Family of Blobs
pieces.note: The same blob built four ways: harmonic, grown, contoured, implicit. One ink, one plate, the comparison is the picture.

pieces.title: Standing-Wave Hatch
pieces.note: A hatch field where a sine wave decides how long each dash gets. Blades of darkness swim through the lines.

pieces.title: Hue Bingo Canvas
pieces.note: Every visit rolls a fresh Hue Bingo palette and lays it down as wobbling colour rings. Coherent by construction.

pieces.title: Gesture Atlas
pieces.note: Draw a stroke and the atlas finds its nearest cousin in the corpus, snapping it under your hand. Endpoints count most.

pieces.title: Eight Bad Chips
pieces.note: Eight synth chips, each with one labeled manufacturing fault. The ensemble of its own failures.

pieces.title: Pairs Only
pieces.note: Sixty-four oscillators, spendable in pairs. Rich voices starve their neighbors.

pieces.title: Master Frequency Only
pieces.note: Every sound frozen as a spectral recipe; your only control is one master wheel. Timbre intact, pitch yours.

pieces.title: The 3:5:7
pieces.note: A brass staircase of thirteen steps to the tritave, lit by odd partials, ending on a 3:5:7 cadence.

pieces.title: Lattice Choir
pieces.note: Chords built on a fractional-octave lattice, consonant by construction. Three voices blooming at once.

pieces.title: Wrong Octave, Right Key
pieces.note: Stretch the octave from 2.0 to 2.6 under a familiar tune. It stays recognizable while the tonic refuses to resolve.

pieces.title: Seventeen Microns
pieces.note: A slider for droplet size against a fixed updraft. Find by eye where float becomes rain.

pieces.title: Eight Minutes
pieces.note: This piece only exists during eight-minute fog windows. Between them, a countdown and a tide table of past openings.

pieces.title: Mold and Chisel
pieces.note: Fog-sculpture instrument: you place the emitters, the wind does the carving. The last sculpture lingers as a ghost.

pieces.title: Over Under
pieces.note: Seeded Celtic knotwork: strands turn at every wall, crossings alternate over and under, a plaited frame with corner bosses. Click for a fresh knot.

pieces.title: The Exactness Gate
pieces.note: Detune the loop by fractions of a semitone and watch song-ness collapse. Exactness as a game.

pieces.title: Ten Times Exact
pieces.note: One recording played ten times byte-identically while the picture turns into notation. Your ears flip before your eyes do.

pieces.title: Tritave Rose
pieces.note: Structure repeating at 3x instead of 2x: thirteen rings, marks sized by consonance, slow revolution.

pieces.title: Prime Petals
pieces.note: A rosette in prime-numbered hues only. Each prime family grows exactly p petals.

pieces.title: Clang
pieces.note: Sixteen agents cycle seven ink marks through a 54-second arc, punctuated by three clangs.

pieces.title: Held and Shaped
pieces.note: Two panels, one material: pulse holds while color shapes, then they trade jobs every 24 seconds.

pieces.title: Trough Walk
pieces.note: An octave as a washboard of tuning valleys. The probe snaps into troughs; wide ratios eat narrow ones.

pieces.title: Convergence
pieces.note: A tilted crystal of 5-limit harmony. Pulses converge on the root and bloom on arrival.

pieces.title: Retune
pieces.note: Two offset circle grids plus a sheared dot grid. Drag to retune and watch the moire re-resolve.

pieces.title: Hover
pieces.note: Marks breathing at the edge of visibility. Your pointer steadies them.

pieces.title: Scale Loom
pieces.note: A tuning ladder woven like cloth: fifteen rungs, the pattern re-segmenting live.

pieces.title: Possible Worlds
pieces.note: Pascal's triangle as a map of chord worlds. Click a cell to open its diagram.

pieces.title: Face Walk
pieces.note: Erv Wilson's hexany as a navigable octahedron. Triads named and sounded in just intonation.

pieces.title: Five Methods
pieces.note: One scalar field rebuilt five ways: contour, stipple, hatch, tone cells, drift. Portraits of methods.

pieces.title: Reverse Lookup
pieces.note: Drag across a hue spectrum while the piece ranks its palette by simplicity. Vetoes shown struck through.

pieces.title: One Series Two Materials
pieces.note: One logarithmic series drives both a ribbon's geometry and a striker's rhythm. Same structure, felt twice.

pieces.title: Fusion Threshold
pieces.note: Dots accelerate until they stop being dots and become tone. A meter marks the moment.

pieces.title: Mark the Seam
pieces.note: Twelve pure fifths tiled as kites, the 23.46-cent comma concentrated into one brass wedge.

pieces.title: Fifty-Three Divisions
pieces.note: The octave divided into 53 commas, brass seams and all. Hover to read each comma in cents.

pieces.title: Bleed Ledger
pieces.note: Three hands negotiate on a ruled ledger: hidden pigment, pitted wounds, gravity-drawn streaks. Every trail reads back to its wound.

pieces.title: Value Ramp Grid
pieces.note: Half-square triangles in a deliberate diagonal gradient, light to dark. Nothing else.

pieces.title: Greedy Squiggle
pieces.note: A plotter pen hunts the darkest pixel left on the page, erasing as it goes, lifting to relocate. Mostly one line.

pieces.title: Eye Garden
pieces.note: A garden of eye sprouts that watch your pointer go by, pupils widening, then settle back to sleep. Sweep through it.

pieces.title: Typewriter Weave
pieces.note: Struck one character at a time with a shaky hand. Up close it reads as typing; from across the room it reads as cloth.

pieces.title: Living Homage
pieces.note: After Albers, but the squares never sit still: one slow palette journey, sizes breathing out of phase. Click to mint a fresh journey.

pieces.title: Mud Map
pieces.note: Three mud zones on the hue wheel, marked dead, and every trapped color drawing its own escape arc to the edge. Click to scatter the colors again.

pieces.title: Almost Perfect
pieces.note: One pen, one line, never lifted: nested squares whose rotation drifts as the path goes in. It draws itself like a plotter. Click for a new hand.

pieces.title: Wind Bent
pieces.note: Concentric rings sampled through a wind field that pushes in every direction. Click for a fresh gust.

pieces.title: Own Lines
pieces.note: Every stroke is built by hand from shaded triangles, width shaped by pressure, so the line keeps a brush's habits. One study per click: a wave, a heron, bamboo, a grass tuft.

pieces.title: Half a Million Grains
pieces.note: Half a million grains of sandpaint falling one by one. Nothing is drawn except dots, and the picture emerges. Click the paper for a burst.

pieces.title: Orbit Portraits
pieces.note: Strange attractors rendered like flame fractals. Every roll picks an orbit; a laciness test hangs the keepers and stamps the duds on the reject wall.

pieces.title: Tone Rows
pieces.note: A polargraph density study: vertical ticks drawn row by row, length following tone, whites lifting the pen. A rose window in machine handwriting.

pieces.title: Off Register
pieces.note: A playable print-shop instrument: twelve one-gesture motifs on keys A to L, each printed twice with a ghost-ink offset like the sheet slipped. Tap on mobile.

pieces.title: What Isn't There
pieces.note: A poster printed in reverse: every word exists only as erasure, carved, rubbed and punched out of the ink. Read the gaps.

pieces.title: Half-Moon Dots
pieces.note: A breathing dotted field crossed by a slowly rotating crescent. Dots that straddle the edge are drawn bisected, so the boundary itself is the subject.

pieces.title: Hour Hands
pieces.note: A clock that repaints itself every minute: three rings for seconds, minutes and hours, each a slow journey between two colors. Click the piece to hold a still.

pieces.title: Still Life
pieces.note: Two to four vessels on a low table, drawn flat with long shadows and one accent pot per arrangement. The horizon never lands in the same place twice. Click the piece for a new seating.

pieces.title: Feedback
pieces.note: One buffer of noise re-sampled through its own ghost until it settles into flowing grain. The settle is the event. Click the piece to run it again.

pieces.title: Storm Grid
pieces.note: Forty-nine nested squares drawn with a plotter's patience, except in two or three cells where the hand slipped. Click the piece for a new plot.

pieces.title: Interruptions
pieces.note: A dense weave of short ink dashes, each the same length and turned at random, with whole regions erased back to paper. The holes are the drawing. Click for a new variation.

pieces.title: Kaleid 99
pieces.note: Oscillator bands through a ninety-nine-mirror kaleidoscope, thresholded into hard stripes and printed to near black on paper. One band of color keeps the rest honest. Click for a new variation.

pieces.title: Kindling
pieces.note: Two fractal flames built from pure density, drifting into each other and back. Bright cores dissolving into smoke. Click for a new burn.

pieces.title: Lichtenberg
pieces.note: A crystal grown from static. Thousands of sparks drift in out of the dark and freeze the instant they touch the tree. Nothing here was drawn, only accreted. Click to grow a new one.

pieces.title: Tangency
pieces.note: A circle-packing study. Discs are placed largest first and grown until each touches a neighbor, so every circle is tangent to something. Rings and arc segments in rust, ochre, and slate on warm paper. Click for a new variation.

pieces.title: Strata
pieces.note: An imaginary terrain sliced like a museum model: translucent elevation layers floating in a dark studio, one warm layer among the ink blues. Drag to look around, click for a new landscape.

pieces.title: Overprint
pieces.note: Two ink passes over one quarter-circle grid: indigo first, rust second and a little off register, the way a tired press would lay it down. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Old Courses
pieces.note: An 1881 survey of a river that never flowed, thirteen channels deep. Click the piece for a new survey.

pieces.title: Field Notes
pieces.note: Wind, recorded the way a field notebook would: inked curves combed across the page, with one red thread running through. Click the piece for a new page.

pieces.title: Corridor
pieces.note: A quadtree of geometric motifs, camera-projected into an endless corridor. This one moves. Click the piece for a new corridor.

pieces.title: Tone Mosaic
pieces.note: An etching pressed from a thousand voronoi cells, where cell size does all the shading. Click the piece for a new plate.

pieces.title: Congregation
pieces.note: A living web of three hundred forty seeds that breathes with its own synthesized heartbeat, gathering at every kick. This one moves and makes sound. Click the piece to start it.

pieces.title: Murmuration
pieces.note: Six hundred particles hold a word that shivers but never lands, until a gust scatters them and they find their letters again. This one moves. Click the piece for a new word.

pieces.title: Growth
pieces.note: A line that follows only local rules grows into folds no hand would draw. This one grows while you watch. Click the piece for a new growth.

pieces.title: Bloom
pieces.note: Exact geometry in ink first, then watercolor washes bloom over it and dry where they want. Click the piece for a fresh sheet.

pieces.title: Oscillons
pieces.note: Waveforms drawn the way an oscilloscope draws them, layered in phosphor tones on dark. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Interference
pieces.note: Wheels of fine lines turn at different speeds, and where they cross, new patterns bloom and dissolve. This one moves. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Strata Break
pieces.note: Concentric rings dissolving from order into chaos, with one red ring. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Three Shapes
pieces.note: A tangent chain of circles, squares, and triangles in two inks, construction lines left visible. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Mai Menochot
pieces.note: A rising sun in two passes of ink over still water, the rust pass deliberately misregistered like a slipped letterpress bed. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Contour Fields
pieces.note: Contour lines over imaginary terrain, each drawn a little unsteadily so they read as hand inked. They bunch up where the ground gets steep. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Subdivide
pieces.note: A rectangle keeps splitting until every piece earns a texture: hatching, stipple, rings, the odd flat solid. Only adjacent to Mondrian in method. Click the piece for a new variation.

pieces.title: Accumulation
pieces.note: Sixteen thousand grains of light dropped one by one until a moon, a ridge, a wave, or a forest gathers out of the dust. Click the piece for a new sky.

pieces.title: Personal Weather
pieces.note: A field of wind barbs, each with a heading of its own. Your pointer paints weather into the air: fast flicks burn amber, slow drifts stay blue. Move your pointer to stir it.

pieces.title: Flight Deck
pieces.note: Seven fogged depth levels of swirling particle trails, flown through like gates. Click to jump to a fresh system; move the pointer to look around.

pieces.title: Trellis
pieces.note: Type any word and watch it grow into a hedge, leaves and blossoms along every letter, the word still readable through the green.

pieces.title: Wire Garden
pieces.note: One unbroken wire grown from a pool of fragments, bending toward a wandering lure. The wild joints are marked.

pieces.title: Halved
pieces.note: One random polygon. Draw a line through it and every polygon the line crosses splits in two, in tonal steps. Cut as far as you like.

pieces.title: Sides II
pieces.note: Dot to circle, skipping sides: readable polygons then a quick rush to round.

pieces.title: Sides
pieces.note: Dot becomes line, triangle, square, gains sides until a circle, returns to dot.

pieces.title: Unison
pieces.note: Continuous spawn every 2s: all squares rotate the same direction.

pieces.title: Square One
pieces.note: One square: its sides unwrap into a single line as it turns, then fold back.

pieces.title: Slat Light
pieces.note: Low sun through a fence, the sun itself offstage. Long soft shadows rake across paper, deepening where they overlap, and one warm band falls where a slat is missing. Click for another evening.

pieces.title: Wind Field
pieces.note: A gust frozen mid-passage through wheat, every blade leaning downwind, the bend swelling where the gust is strongest. One red poppy stands unbent. Click for another field.

pieces.title: Crows on a Wire
pieces.note: Five on the wire and one just leaving. A small moment, drawn plainly, under a big empty sky. Click for another morning.

pieces.title: Lunar Strip
pieces.note: One lunation in twenty-nine moons, waxing to a gold full moon and waning again, each terminator hand-wobbled. Click for another sky.

pieces.title: Frost
pieces.note: First frost on the pane. Ink-blue crystals creep in from the corners and stop, leaving the middle clear to breathe. Click for another morning.

pieces.title: River Stones
pieces.note: A quiet bed of river stones, each water-worn smooth, overlaps deepening honestly. One moss-green stone among the gray. Click for another arrangement.

pieces.title: Smoke
pieces.note: One breath, made visible. A single column of smoke rises, widens, and dissolves into empty paper. Click for another.

pieces.title: What Is Generative Art
pieces.note: The artist writes the rules, the machine rolls the dice, and a family comes out. One branching system, six children, one keeper. Click for another family.

pieces.title: Square Fountain
pieces.note: Hypnotic loop: squares spawn center, grow and rotate, dissolve at max size.

pieces.title: Deliberately Uninteresting
pieces.note: After Sol LeWitt. Thousands of identical marks; the composition lives in coverage, never in the mark. Up close it is nothing but handwriting, at distance a curve. Click for another field.

pieces.title: Eternal Bloom
pieces.note: Continuous spawn every 2s: squares expand and rotate at uniform rates, alternating direction.

pieces.title: The Shadow of One Letter
pieces.note: A red wireframe solid, hand-drawn, casting a shadow built from one repeated dot. The shadow's edge and density do the drawing. Click for another casting.

pieces.title: Tidepool Contours
pieces.note: A rock shelf at low tide, read as depth bands. The pools breathe, small crabs work the wet rock, and a click drops a pebble.

pieces.title: Ruled Lines
pieces.note: Dense hand-drawn rules in ballpoint blue on paper. A hidden field lifts the lines — the ghost of a circular presence you feel before you see.

pieces.title: Weave
pieces.note: Warp and weft threads crossing in plain weave. Each thread alternates over and under at every crossing, like real cloth.

pieces.title: Misregister
pieces.note: One geometric form pulled three times in cyan, magenta and yellow, each plate offset like a misregistered print. The color is the misregistration.

pieces.title: Dusk Shore
pieces.note: A pixel-art beach from above at dusk, drawn with code. The shoreline breathes, wave bands drift, sun glitter twinkles gold, and tiny figures wait at the foam edge.

pieces.title: Meridian
pieces.note: Flowing meridian lines in blue-violet. Drag to stir.

pieces.title: Marine Snow
pieces.note: The dropped 9055s background polished into its own piece: a quiet water column with slanting light shafts, layered drifting marine snow, and a whisper of distant glow. No creature.

pieces.title: Folded Light
pieces.note: One palette, three panels, three moods.

pieces.title: Patch Mountain
pieces.note: A mountain built from nothing but patches: directional color strokes on a reserved dark ground, no outlines anywhere.

pieces.title: Crosscurrent
pieces.note: Dark and pale ribbons ride the same current and never touch. Click for a new current.

pieces.title: Hundred
pieces.note: A fixed edition of one hundred prints. Click to walk the edition.

pieces.title: Underdrawing
pieces.note: The scaffolding first, then the paint. Watch it build, click to rebuild.

pieces.title: Driftlines
pieces.note: Hairline currents; tone drawn from the water's speed. Click for another drift.

pieces.title: Loom
pieces.note: Threads strung on nested rings, pulled taut or left slack; gold warps over the weave. Click for another weaving.

pieces.title: Grainfield
pieces.note: Twenty-five thousand dots settle where the current bends. Click for another field.

pieces.title: Faultline
pieces.note: The curves are banned: hard turns, bold faults, sudden slips. Click for another fault.

pieces.title: Undertow
pieces.note: Rings bent by a slow current crowd into dark bands. Click for another undertow.

pieces.title: Silt
pieces.note: Layers of earth settle, darken with depth, and slip once along a pale seam. Click for another silt.

pieces.title: Meridian
pieces.note: Meridians bend around slow vortices; the strays burn warmer. Click for another meridian.

pieces.title: Alluvium
pieces.note: River mouths spill fans of sediment that overlap and settle over each other. Click for another alluvium.

pieces.title: Orchard
pieces.note: Packed canopies from above, big trees first, fruit in rust. Click for another orchard.

pieces.title: Solstice
pieces.note: A low vermilion sun, warm rays up and cool rays down. Click for another solstice.

pieces.title: Well
pieces.note: Squares turn a little further as they shrink, down a twisting shaft. Click for another well.

pieces.title: Raster
pieces.note: A strict dot grid sized by two rings arguing. Click for another raster.

pieces.title: Hatch
pieces.note: One family of lines, swelling and thinning around a hidden light. Click for another hatch.

pieces.title: Warp
pieces.note: A checkerboard bulging under two crossing waves. Click for another warp.

pieces.title: Quarter Turn
pieces.note: Coin-flip tiles chain their arcs into paths nobody drew. Click for another quarter turn.

pieces.title: Compass
pieces.note: Needles lean with a seeded weather of direction; the vertical ones turn rust. Click for another compass.

pieces.title: Shimmer
pieces.note: Dashed rings interfere until the field seems to move; one ring burns vermilion. Click for another shimmer.

pieces.title: Impasto
pieces.note: Thick palette-knife color blocks in a stained-glass jigsaw, after Jason Anderson.

pieces.title: Concrete
pieces.note: Hard-edge geometric shapes on a strict grid, slowly reconfiguring. Tap to rearrange.

pieces.title: Swell
pieces.note: Thick impasto seascape: foam-white horizon over deep teal water, after Jason Anderson.

pieces.title: Afterglow
pieces.note: Blazing sunset sky over dark silhouette land, thick palette-knife bands, after Jason Anderson.

pieces.title: Undertow
pieces.note: Luminous particles ride a curl-noise current on near-black, drawing the undertow itself.

pieces.title: Murmur
pieces.note: Luminous particles coalesce into a glowing ring, hold, and dissolve. A seamless loop.

pieces.title: Fission
pieces.note: Recursive subdivision grid, splitting and healing. Tap to divide.

pieces.title: Shear
pieces.note: Diagonal bars and wedges on a leaning energy band. Tap to flip.

pieces.title: Crosscurrent
pieces.note: Two ink currents cross an evolving flow field. Drag to stir, double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Split Tide
pieces.note: A recursive subdivision that breathes on a seamless loop. Drag to scrub time.

pieces.title: Rhizome
pieces.note: A root network that grows, prunes itself, and is reborn in breathing seasons. Drag to bend the growth; double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Interference
pieces.note: Overlapping wave fields drawn as a breathing field of ink dots on paper. Drag to drop a stone; double-tap for new waves.

pieces.title: Ember Knot
pieces.note: Luminous particles stream along a torus knot on near-black, colored like cooling embers. Drag to orbit; double-tap to reset.

pieces.title: Cipher
pieces.note: Code-drawn glyphs orbit in concentric rings at different speeds. Drag to stir; double-tap to reseed.

pieces.title: Gossamer
pieces.note: Verlet silk on a slow wind field. Drag to disturb it.

pieces.title: Perigee
pieces.note: One closed harmonograph orbit, one traveler. A seamless loop.

pieces.title: Pinwheel Quilt
pieces.note: Ink pinwheels on a warped lattice, after a hand-drawn quilt. A seamless loop; double-tap re-sews it.

pieces.title: Pinwheel Quilt II
pieces.note: Closer to the hand-drawn original: portrait lattice, stronger swirl, wilder warp. A seamless loop; double-tap re-sews it.

pieces.title: Linkwork
pieces.note: After the forged wall sculpture: interlocking bronze and blackened-steel links, hand-hammered, each at its own depth. A slow light sweep crosses the metal; double-tap re-forges it.

pieces.title: Linkwork II
pieces.note: Second study after the forged wall sculpture: a denser, more tangled cluster of bronze and blackened-steel links. A slow light sweep crosses the metal; double-tap re-forges it.

pieces.title: Linkwork III
pieces.note: Third study after the forged wall sculpture, rebuilt from the chain: crisp rectangular links flowing horizontally, each passing alternately over and under its neighbours. A slow ripple travels the chain; double-tap re-forges it.

pieces.title: Inkwell
pieces.note: Ink dropped in dark water: slow blooms open, curl, and dissolve on a seamless loop. Watch only.
